metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: We want to maximize the clones of Chris that can get a lot of likes on Facebook.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: OK, just returning briefly to the moment, the topic of AI. Are you working on AI stuff too?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: A lot of machine learning tools for genomics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I was seeing this interspersed because there's such a biology, I suppose computational biology person. But what about the are you working on age of prediction?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Yes. Yeah. So you've heard about the book, I guess. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Yeah. What that's actually written with the philanthropist I mentioned who we named the fungus of the space station.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So that's coming out next year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: What's the effort there? What's what's your interest in sort of the more narrow AI tools of prediction and machine learning, all that kind of stuff?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I think called the age of prediction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So the next book that's coming is all the ways where machine learning tools, predictive algorithms have fundamentally changed our lives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So some of them are obvious to me where, for example, when we sequence cancer patients DNA and we have predictions of exactly which drug will work with that, that's actually a very simple algorithm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But other ones involve predicting, say, the age of blood that's left at the scene of a crime, which uses computational tools to look at each piece of DNA and what it might reveal for its epigenetic state and then predicting essentially how old you are at any given moment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And that's also gets to longevity, because sometimes you can see if you're getting if you're aging faster or slower than you should be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So some tools are in medicine or even forensics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But my favorite part, a lot of the book is where does this show up in economics as well as in medicine?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So predictive tools, I mean, I think the most notorious one people thought of us during the 2012 election and 2016 election, especially we were seeing these really big differences of how Facebook was monitoring feeds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And so prediction is not just better medicine or in finance and economics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: People think about stock traders, people doing predictive algorithms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But how you what you view in your feed, how you what your vote is and what you saw.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Facebook did experiments, they call it social contagion experiments to see, can we restructure what people see and then how they respond actually kind of be really predictive and manipulative, frankly, with what happens and then can that change how they vote?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And the answer seemed to be yes, for a good amount of the populace in 2016 in the US.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So I think we're seeing more and more of these algorithms show up all over the place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And so the book is about where they appear, where they're good, for example, in medicine, they're phenomenal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: They have fundamentally changed how we treat cancer patients.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But where they're risky, like if someone's trying to steal your vote or manipulate your thoughts potentially negatively.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So in medicine, you're hopeful about prediction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Yeah, most of the AI in medicine, the machine learning tools for image recognition, for example, for pathology samples, we normally think of you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Oh, someone takes a bit of a bit of tissue and then puts it onto a slide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Normally, there's pathologists that have been training for years to look at a chunk of your tissue and say, OK, is this cancer?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: What kind of cancer? What treatment should I do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But there's an old joke about pathologists that you can give 10 slides to 10 different pathologists and get 11 different diagnoses, which is as awful as it sounds,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: because you're having someone squint at a stained microscope slide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But instead, if you use a lot of the AI tools where you can actually segment the image, high resolution characterization with multiple probes, it's what AI was built to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: You have a large training data set and then you have test samples afterward.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: You can you can do far better than almost every pathologist on the planet and get a much more accurate diagnostic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So that's for breast cancer, for prostate cancer, for leukemia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: We've seen the diagnostic tools explode with AI power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Is it currently mostly empowering doctors or can it replace doctors?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Watson, when notoriously was made by IBM to try and replace doctors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I love IBM so much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I was in the room when we got a tour of Watson for the first time with the dean of our medical school.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And these programmers came out and they said, listen, here's this example of a patient and watch Watson diagnose the patient and recommend the right treatment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And then at one point in the conversation, remember, this is a room of I'm a PhDs, like a geneticist and programmers, some MDs, leaders of the of the medical school.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: The dean is there and he says, you can imagine someday this could replace doctors in a room full of doctors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Right. So it was a really poor choice of words.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: It's like, no, you want to help the doctors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But but but I think the view from the programmers is often a bit naive that they could fundamentally replace doctors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Now, in some cases, they can for the pathology description.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I just mentioned, I think the AI tools already do a better job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And we've only really been doing this for about five years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So you imagine another five years of optimization and data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: They're going to take over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And they should, because staring and squinting at screens for hours a day is not the best use of human ingenuity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So I think some cases they'll take over other cases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: They'll augment. They'll help. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: That human ingenuity actually, especially for AI people, sometimes difficult to characterize as this debate all the time about autonomous driving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: There is it's a lot more difficult than people realize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: You're an expert. You focus a lot on that for your research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I'm an expert in nothing except in not being an expert.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Or asking stupid questions with the answers both.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: OK. But there is some ingenuity that's hard to kind of encapsulate that is human for a doctor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: The decision making is the Hal 9000.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: You can have a perfect system that is able to know the optimal answer, but there's some human element that's missing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And sometimes the suboptimal answer in the long term is the right one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: It's the self-doubt that is essential for human progress.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: That's weird. I'm not not sure what that is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: If I can, let me ask you to be the wise old sage and give advice to young people today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Sure. In high school, in college, about how to have a career they can be proud of or maybe a life they can be proud of on this planet or or others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I think for the Paduans out there and young younglings looking up at the stars, you have to know that this day that you're alive is quantifiably the best day that's ever happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And that tomorrow will be even better than this day in terms of the capacity for discovery, the amount of data that exists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Again, it's not my opinion. That's just an empirical fact of the state of genetics, research, knowledge, accretion of humanities, acumen for many disciplines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So with that ability to do so many things, it can be sometimes just terrifying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Well, what do I pick if I could do everything in this most possibility ever in human history?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: How do you pick one thing to do? And that's just the thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: What do you find yourself daydreaming about? What's the thing that you what keeps you up at night?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: If you don't have anything that keeps you up at night, sometimes you go find something that keeps you up at night.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: That is kind of this sometimes I feel like if I get woken up by the someone on the inside of my skull who's knocking, trying to get out, it's kind of that almost haunting feeling of I need to wake up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: There's things that have to be done. There are questions I don't know the answer to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And a lot of times it's simple as how do we engineer cells to survive more radiation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But what I read a paper and then it came back to me a week later as hell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: You could use some of these tools or these genes or these methods really being pleasantly haunted by something is a wonderful place to be and find that thing that bothers you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Because there'll be good days and there'll be bad days, but you want to have even on the worst possible days working on the thing that you love the most.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And then all the usual normal phrases apply.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Like then you never work a day in your life if you have a job you love the usual phrases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But it's true. And it's actually really hard to find.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I think a lot of times you'll have to do work for random jobs that maybe you don't like for five or even 10 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: You may have to go to school for 10 to 15 to 20 years to finally get to the right spot where you have the knowledge, the experience and even frankly just reputation that people trust you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: You've done enough good work and only then can you really do the thing you love most.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But so you have to be a little bit patient, be a little bit patient and impatient at the same time. You have to do both.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And the interesting thing is when you're trying to find that thing that excites you, you have to, especially in this modern world, I think, silence the distractions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Because once you find that thing, you hear that little voice in your head, there's still Instagram and TikTok and video games and other exciting sort of dopamine rushes that can like pull you away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And make it seem like they're the same thing, but they're not really. There's some little flame there that's longer lasting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And I think you have to silence everything else to let that sort of flame become a fire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So it's interesting because so much of the Internet is designed to convert that natural predisposition that humans have to get excited about stuff, convert that into like attention and money and ads and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But like we have to be conscious of that. I think a lot of that is full of fun and is awesome. I think TikTok and Instagram that's full of fun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And creativity leads to people making amazing videos or even doing people. My daughter loves TikTok and people who do makeup art on TikTok of things that are mind blowing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: You think they made that video just to put it on TikTok and practice their art and share it with the world. It's fabulous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But then if my daughter watches TikTok for like three hours straight, I'm like, what are you doing exactly? And she's like, well, you know, so it's art.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But I mean, when I was a kid, I played Nintendo. I sometimes would play for like 10 hours a day. Even in grad school, I'd sometimes play like Counter-Strike or Half-Life like 12 hours straight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And I'm like, what was I? So at one point, I built a new computer. I just didn't install some of the games I had on for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I was like, I'm just going to not install them because otherwise I'll play them for too long.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I would love to get props from the team. I would love to lay out all the things I've ever done in my life to myself because I think I would be less judgmental of others and less understanding, more patient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Because the amount of hours I spent playing like Diablo and like video like is insane.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I'm sure it adds up to like weeks, maybe months of my life that was just, you know, but I feel like I was probably I tell myself at least I was problem solving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Right. It's a hand-eye coordination or that's an old I don't know if that really is remotely true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But some of the games like Final Fantasy things are things we actually had to solve problems and think and they were some degree of strategy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But they were actually just expanding the diversity of human character that makes up you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: It's like you can't just focus on that you can't but perhaps it's more beneficial to focus to not focus on a singular thing for many, many years at a time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: That could be one of the downsides of a PhD if you're not careful is that you become too singularly focused not just on the problem but on a particular community.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And you don't do wild stuff. You don't do interdisciplinary stuff. You don't go out painting or getting drunk or dancing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Whatever the variety, whatever injects variety to the years of difficult reading research paper after research paper that whole process.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: You have to be very careful to add variety into it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And maybe that involves playing a little bit of Counter-Strike or Diablo whatever floats your boat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: New York City is a great place for this. There's sunrise rooftop dancing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: We've got a party that does this. That's the thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: It's the thing. So you go there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I've only been once but at sunrise and you see the sunrise over the city and there's huge house music and you play and you dance like crazy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And then you go to work. You go to lab. You go to wherever you go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But it's good to squeeze in some weird crazy sunrise rooftop dancing or things like that when you can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: If we can, if we may, to some difficult dark places.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I'll bring a flashlight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Maybe something, find something that can warm your soul or inspires others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Is there a dark period, dark times in your life that you had to overcome?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Yeah, like many people had friends I've lost. I had a friend when I was younger who committed suicide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And that was actually, I remember being so struck of, I couldn't understand it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I didn't understand mental illness at the time. I was very young. I was only I think 11 at the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And I really was confused more than anything else about how could someone take their life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And actually once I got over the grief of it all, it cemented in my head that I would never commit suicide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I actually tell this to my wife.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: She's like, if it looks like I hung myself, go find my killer because I would never do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: It's got to be staged.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But at the same time, I've begun to appreciate there are times where the suffering is so great and diseases can be so awful that sometimes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: euthanasia is an actual exit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But I just have friends I've lost along the way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But that's not too different. Everyone has people they've lost along the way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But I actually was never too dark of a childhood or a dark place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I mean, the hardest things have been really weird relationship breakups where I felt like, you know, love, falling in love and then losing that person,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: just breaking up, not like they died, but where you felt like, you know, you just could barely move.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And like you literally felt like your heart was moved in your body to a different location and that sort of scraping sense of existence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But also at the same time, that's been where I've in some ways been the most alive,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: where I lost the what I thought at the time was the love of my life and but then was able to actually,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I think, carve a deeper trench into my heart, which then could be filled more with joy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I would say is what Pablo Neruda wrote about this and Khalil Gibran is that the deepest, deepest sorrows,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I think later have translated into my life as to places that can be filled with greater amounts of joy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I love thinking of sorrows as a digging of a ditch that can then be filled with more good stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Eventually, not at the time, but for a while it's just a giant empty cavern full of like blood and tears and pain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But then it comes later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: There is an element to life where this too shall pass.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Yeah. So any moment of sorrow or joy, it's going to be over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And like treasure it no matter what.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I mean, I do definitely think about losing love. That's like a celebration of love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And even any living, I think is better. That's why I just added, I don't think I'd ever really commit suicide,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: because anything I take is better than nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Like I said, the worst case scenario, there's no heaven, there's no hell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: That's just it. If you just die and that's really just it, then anything that you have in living is by definition

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: infinitely better than the zero, because at least it's something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And so I appreciate sadness. I enjoy sadness, which sounds like an oxymoron,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: but I sometimes even long for a good sadness, like a rainy day and I'm staring out a window squinting

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: and drinking some underpriced whiskey and then just moping.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And like, what are you doing? I'm just moping today. But I want at least one day where I do that or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I actually had a conversation offline with Rick Rubin. He's a music producer about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And he told me he has a way of speaking that's like sage-like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And he says, be careful that you spend some time appreciating that sadness, but don't become addicted to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: That there's a line you can cross and then you actually push away the joy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Because you feel like the sadness can be all encompassing and therefore even more real than what might seem like fleeting happiness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Yes. Yeah, right. You can. Sadness, if you let it, can be a thing that stays with you longer and stickier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But just witnessing suicide made you appreciate life more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And appreciation of death is actually an appreciation of life at the same time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Are you afraid of your death? No. You think about it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I think it's like being afraid of the sunrise. It doesn't make sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So you're part of this fabric that is humanity. And then you just think generationally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Yeah, I think I want to do as much as I can. I feel like I would die. I feel like I've lived a full life already.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I actually believe that since age 17 onward. I feel like even then. I mean, then the bar was low.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I feel like I had at least sex once. I had had good friends. What else is there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But then I had also really read a lot of philosophy, had traveled a bit, felt like I'd started to at least see the world and had lived somewhat of a life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But from then on, I felt like that I wouldn't feel like I was cheated if I had died from that day forward.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: That I had gotten at least enough of life to feel like I would be not okay with dying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But that I feel like I knew I was going to die. I wasn't afraid I was going to die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And it actually was very liberating. And it's only gotten better since then.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So I think some of that may or may not have been drug-related euphoria. But nonetheless, the joy stuck.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I think it's just gotten more true ever since.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: The default state is one of very rich appreciation because it's so fleeting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I knew I would die happy, I guess, even at age 17. But now my metrics have changed a little bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I've had sex more than one time now. So that's really big.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Congratulations. This is very exciting news.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: At least four times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Multiples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And professionally accomplished things. I actually do some of the genetic dreams I had when I was 16 or 17.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I'm now actually making them in my lab.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I actually like to say my scientific goals and statements have really been the same since I've been 17.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: It's just now everyone takes me seriously because I'm a professor and actually I've done the thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And you're mentoring people, you're educating also patients.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Yeah, and helping patients live longer and seeing the hope in their eyes when they went from a...

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Even my own grandfather went from a two-month diagnosis of living from metastatic cancer to living for more than two years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Eventually he succumbed to it, but knowing can use the tools of predictive medicine to save people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And so now looking ahead, I feel like I would die very happy if I saw boots on the Red Planet and people there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And the other advice to the younglings I'd say is...

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: The first time I proposed the twin study to NASA, they said no several times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: They said no, we don't have a plan for a mission like that. It's not going to happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So just persevere as the old...

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I didn't know. I knew you were part of leading the NASA twin study, but you were also part of the failure to do so early.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So the first... actually, because when you start a lab in academia, they say here's a pile of money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Write grants and bring in more money and train people and start a lab.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So I actually wrote NASA and said I'm not requesting any funds. I have funds. They just gave me a bunch of money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I would like to, though, do a deep genetic profile of astronauts before and after spaceflight

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: and do it ideally if we have some twins or do genetics and epigenetics and microbiome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But John Charles, who's the director of the Human Resources Research Program, said no, we don't have...

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: We don't even have those samples banked that you would want that are old samples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And we don't have any plans for missions like that right now. So we can't do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And that was the first time I... It's like saying to someone, listen, I'll buy a house for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I just have this mile by. And they're like, no, no thanks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Because I felt like I was offering a really unique research opportunity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But then that failure of saying that we're not ready yet, it's not time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But then once they had the solicitation, then he reached out and said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: oh, actually, I think we've got something along the lines of what you were thinking a few years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So sometimes when some things get rejected or someone says no, say, OK, maybe it's just too early.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But don't give up, I think, and say, no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So to me, when someone says no, not right now, I'll be like, OK, I'll just come back in a year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: No just means no for now. And so if I think it's...

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Sometimes no means you have a crappy idea. That is true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I do have crappy ideas and so does everybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But if I really believe in it, I just say, OK, I'll be back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Yeah. This too shall pass, the no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Do you hope to go out to ISS, out to deep space one day?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I would love to go. I want to be a little bit older so that if I die, it's not as traumatic for my daughter and family.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But yeah, I feel like if I'm a little bit older, definitely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I would even potentially do a one way trip to Mars later in life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So would you like to? Do you think you will step foot on Mars?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I would love to and I think I might.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I think it may be that one way trip because I think they'll need settlers who would want to go and stay there and build and be there for the long term, knowing it's high risk, knowing it's...

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And your resume fits. So you'll have a lot of cool stuff to do there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Yeah, I could help.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: At least on the surface, you'll be able to sell yourself well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Resilience, experience, motivation. Would that make you sad to die on Mars?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Looking back at the planet you were born on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: No, I think it would be actually in some ways, maybe the best way to die, knowing that you're in the first wave of people expanding the reaching of the stars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: It would be an honor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Why do you think we're here? What's the meaning of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: To serve as the guardians of life itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: That is the duty for our species is to recognize and really manifest this unique responsibility that we have and only we have so far.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I think to me the meaning of life is for life to, in its simplest form, is to be able to survive, but to leverage the frailty of life into its ability to protect itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Quite literally, the guardians of the galaxy is basically what we are. We're guarding ourselves and also life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I mean, life is just so precious. As far as we know, it is completely rare in the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And I do think a lot, well, what if this is the only universe that's ever come in and it won't come back again?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And like, this is it. If that's true, we have to serve as its shepherds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Leverage the frailty of life to protect it. And this is all life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So we get the opportunity, we humans get the opportunity to be smart enough, to be clever enough, to be motivated enough to actually protect the other life that's on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Including AI, including life that's to come that might be very different from what we imagine today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And that would make you sad if we were replaced by the kinder, smarter AI?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Nope. I think about that in the book a bit. I think I would be okay with it if they carry some echo of that duty and they bring that with them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: It would be sad if they like, tell everyone we're going to destroy everything we come across and become like nanobots that make everything gray goo.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But that would still be a version of life, just not one that I think is pretty, but technically it'd be alive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So philosophically, could I object? It's borderline.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Yeah, but romantically, no. They need to carry the duty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Yes, there's a bit of a romance to the philosophy that's in there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: And you also end the book with a universe that creates new universes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: So if this isn't the only universe, do you think that's in our future that we might launch new offspring universes?

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: It's very possible. Multiverse is a controversial field because it's very much hypothetical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: But with this universe has been created, the one we're in now, and so it's happened before, it certainly could happen again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Some of them might be happening in parallel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I think if you look at billions of years, trillions of years in the future of technological development, it's certainly possible we could start to have little baby universes, grow them like cabbage, get them out, saute them, make them have flavor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: Yeah, create something delicious. Well, it sounds difficult, but it's our human duty to try.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: As you said, Chris, this is an incredible conversation. You're an incredible person, a scientist, explorer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: I can't wait to see what you do in this world. And I hope to be there with you on Mars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Chris Mason: Space Travel, Colonization, and Long-Term Survival in Space | Lex Fridman Podcast #283

body.input: theoretical physicist at Columbia

body.input: in an Evolving Universe.
