metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I think intelligence, it's so hard to separate it from our desire for self-preservation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: our emotions, all that non-rational stuff that kind of gets in the way of logical thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But because the way, if we're talking about human intelligence or human level intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: whatever that means, a huge part of it is social.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: We were evolved to be social and to deal with other people, and that's just so ingrained

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: in us that it's hard to separate intelligence from that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I think AI for the last 70 years, or however long it's been around, it has largely been

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: separated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: There's this idea that there's like, it's kind of very Cartesian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: There's this thinking thing that we're trying to create, but we don't care about all this

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: other stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I think the other stuff is very fundamental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: There's idea that things like emotion get in the way of intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: As opposed to being an integral part of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Integral part of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I'm Russian, so romanticize the notions of emotion and suffering and all that kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: fear of mortality, those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So in AI, especially- By the way, did you see that there was this

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: recent thing going around the internet of this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Some, I think he's a Russian or some Slavic, had written this thing, sort of anti the idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: of super intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I forgot, maybe he's Polish.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Anyway, so he had all these arguments and one was the argument from Slavic pessimism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: My favorite.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Do you remember what the argument is?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It's like nothing ever works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Everything sucks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So what do you think is the role?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: That's such a fascinating idea that what we perceive as sort of the limits of the human

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: mind, which is emotion and fear and all those kinds of things are integral to intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Could you elaborate on that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Why is that important, do you think, for human level intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: At least the way the humans work, it's a big part of how it affects how we perceive the

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It affects how we make decisions about the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It affects how we interact with other people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It affects our understanding of other people, for me to understand what you're likely to

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I need to have kind of a theory of mind and that's very much a theory of emotions and

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: motivations and goals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: To understand that, we have this whole system of mirror neurons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I sort of understand your motivations through sort of simulating it myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So it's not something that I can prove that's necessary, but it seems very likely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So okay, you've written the op-ed in the New York Times titled, We Shouldn't Be Scared

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: by Superintelligent AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And it criticized a little bit Stuart Russell and Nick Bostrom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Can you try to summarize that article's key ideas?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So it was spurred by an earlier New York Times op-ed by Stuart Russell, which was summarizing

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: his book called Human Compatible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: The article was saying, if we have superintelligent AI, we need to have its values aligned with

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: our values and it has to learn about what we really want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: He gave this example, what if we have a superintelligent AI and we give it the problem of solving

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: climate change and it decides that the best way to lower the carbon in the atmosphere

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: is to kill all the humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So to me, that just made no sense at all because a superintelligent AI, first of all, trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: to figure out what superintelligence means.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And it seems that something that's superintelligent can't just be intelligent along this one

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: dimension of, okay, we're going to figure out all the steps, the best optimal path to

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: solving climate change and not be intelligent enough to figure out that humans don't want

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: to be killed, that you could get to one without having the other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And you know, Bostrom in his book talks about the orthogonality hypothesis where he says

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: he thinks that a system's, I can't remember exactly what it is, but like a system's goals

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: and its values don't have to be aligned.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: There's some orthogonality there, which didn't make any sense to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So you're saying in any system that's sufficiently, not even superintelligent, but as it opposed

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: greater and greater intelligence, there's a holistic nature that will sort of attention

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: that will naturally emerge that prevents it from sort of any one dimension running away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Yeah, yeah, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So you know, Bostrom had this example of the superintelligent AI that turns the world into

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: paper clips because its job is to make paper clips or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And that just as a thought experiment didn't make any sense to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Well as a thought experiment or as a thing that could possibly be realized?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Either.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So I think that, you know, what my op-ed was trying to do was say that intelligence is

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: more complex than these people are presenting it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: That it's not so separable, the rationality, the values, the emotions, all of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: The view that you could separate all these dimensions and build a machine that has one

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: of these dimensions and it's superintelligent in one dimension, but it doesn't have any

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: of the other dimensions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: That's what I was trying to criticize that I don't believe that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So can I read a few sentences from Yoshio Benjy who is always super eloquent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So he writes, I have the same impression as Melanie that our cognitive biases are linked

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: with our ability to learn to solve many problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: There may also be a limiting factor for AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: However, this is a may in quotes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Things may also turn out differently and there's a lot of uncertainty about the capabilities

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: of future machines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But more importantly for me, the value alignment problem is a problem well before we reach

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: some hypothetical superintelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It is already posing a problem in the form of super powerful companies whose objective

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: function may not be sufficiently aligned with humanity's general wellbeing, creating all

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: kinds of harmful side effects.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: He goes on to argue that the orthogonality and those kinds of things, the concerns of

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: just aligning values with the capabilities of the system is something that might come

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: long before we reach anything like superintelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So your criticism is kind of really nice to saying this idea of superintelligence systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: seem to be dismissing fundamental parts of what intelligence would take.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And then Yoshio kind of says, yes, but if we look at systems that are much less intelligent,

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: there might be these same kinds of problems that emerge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But I guess the example that he gives there of these corporations, that's people, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Those are people's values.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I mean, we're talking about people, the corporations are their values are the values of the people

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: who run those corporations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But the idea is the algorithm, that's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So the fundamental person, the fundamental element of what does the bad thing is a human

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But the algorithm kind of controls the behavior of this mass of human beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Which algorithm?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: For a company that's the, for example, if it's an advertisement driven company that

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: recommends certain things and encourages engagement, so it gets money by encouraging engagement

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: and therefore the company more and more, it's like the cycle that builds an algorithm that

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: enforces more engagement and maybe perhaps more division in the culture and so on, so

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I guess the question here is sort of who has the agency?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So you might say, for instance, we don't want our algorithms to be racist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And facial recognition, some people have criticized some facial recognition systems as being racist

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: because they're not as good on darker skin and lighter skin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: That's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But the agency there, the actual facial recognition algorithm isn't what has the agency.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It's not the racist thing, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It's the, I don't know, the combination of the training data, the cameras being used,

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But my understanding of, and I agree with Benjio there that I think there are these

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: value issues with our use of algorithms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But my understanding of what Russell's argument was is more that the machine itself has the

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: agency now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It's the thing that's making the decisions and it's the thing that has what we would

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: call values.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So whether that's just a matter of degree, it's hard to say, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But I would say that's sort of qualitatively different than a face recognition neural network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And to broadly linger on that point, if you look at Elon Musk, or Russell, or Bostrom,

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: people who are worried about existential risks of AI, however far into the future, their

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: argument goes is it eventually happens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: We don't know how far, but it eventually happens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Do you share any of those concerns and what kind of concerns in general do you have about

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: AI that approach anything like existential threat to humanity?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So I would say, yes, it's possible, but I think there's a lot more closer in existential

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: threats to humanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Because you said like a hundred years for, so your time-

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It's more than a hundred years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: More than a hundred years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Maybe even more than 500 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I mean, it's-

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So the existential threats are so far out that the future is, I mean, there'll be a

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: million different technologies that we can't even predict now that will fundamentally

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: change the nature of our behavior, reality, society, and so on before then.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Yeah, I think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And we have so many other pressing existential threats going on right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Nuclear weapons even.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Nuclear weapons, climate problems, poverty, possible pandemics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: You can go on and on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And I think though worrying about existential threat from AI is not the best priority for

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: what we should be worrying about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: That's kind of my view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Because we're so far away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I'm not necessarily criticizing Russell or Bostrom or whoever for worrying about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And I think some people should be worried about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It's certainly fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But I was more sort of getting at their view of what intelligence is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So I was more focusing on their view of superintelligence than just the fact of them worrying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And the title of the article was written by the New York Times editors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I wouldn't have called it that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: We shouldn't be scared by superintelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: If you wrote it, it'd be like, we should redefine what you mean by superintelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I actually said something like superintelligence is not a sort of coherent idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: That's not something the New York Times would put in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And the follow-up argument that Yoshio makes also, not argument but a statement, and I've

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: heard him say it before, and I think I agree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: He kind of has a very friendly way of phrasing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It's good for a lot of people to believe different things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: He's such a nice guy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It's also practically speaking, we shouldn't be, while your article stands, like, Stuart

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Russell does amazing work, Bostrom does amazing work, you do amazing work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And even when you disagree about the definition of superintelligence or the usefulness of

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: even the term, it's still useful to have people that use that term and then argue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I absolutely agree with Benjo there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I think it's great that the New York Times will publish all this stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It's an exciting time to be here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: What do you think is a good test of intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Is natural language ultimately a test that you find the most compelling, like the original,

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: or the higher levels of the Turing test?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Yeah, I still think the original idea of the Turing test is a good test for intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I mean, I can't think of anything better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: The Turing test, the way that it's been carried out so far has been very impoverished, if

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: you will.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But I think a real Turing test that really goes into depth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Like the one that I mentioned, I talk about in the book, I talk about Ray Kurzweil and

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Mitchell Kapoor have this bet that in 2029, I think is the date there, a machine will

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: pass the Turing test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And they have a very specific, many hours, expert judges and all of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And Kurzweil says yes, Kapoor says no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: We only have like nine more years to go to see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: If something, a machine could pass that, I would be willing to call it intelligent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Of course, nobody will.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: They will say that's just a language model, if it does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So you would be comfortable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So language, a long conversation that's, well, yeah, I mean, you're right, because I think

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: probably to carry out that long conversation, you would literally need to have deep common

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: sense understanding of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And conversation is enough to reveal that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So another super fun topic of complexity that you have worked on, written about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Let me ask the basic question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: What is complexity?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So complexity is another one of those terms like intelligence that's perhaps overused.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But my book about complexity was about this wide area of complex systems, studying different

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: systems in nature, in technology, in society, in which you have emergence, kind of like

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I was talking about with intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: We have the brain, which has billions of neurons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And each neuron individually could be said to be not very complex compared to the system

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: as a whole.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But the system, the interactions of those neurons and the dynamics creates these phenomena

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: that we call intelligence or consciousness that we consider to be very complex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So the field of complexity is trying to find general principles that underlie all these

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: systems that have these kinds of emergent properties.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And the emergence occurs from like underlying the complex system is usually simple fundamental

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: interactions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And the emergence happens when there's just a lot of these things interacting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And then most of science to date, can you talk about what is reductionism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Well, reductionism is when you try and take a system and divide it up into its elements,

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: whether those be cells or atoms or subatomic particles, whatever your field is, and then

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: try and understand those elements and then try and build up an understanding of the whole

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: system by looking at sort of the sum of all the elements.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So what's your sense, whether we're talking about intelligence or these kinds of interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: complex systems, is it possible to understand them in a reductionist way, which is probably

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: the approach of most of science today, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I don't think it's always possible to understand the things we want to understand the most.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So I don't think it's possible to look at single neurons and understand what we call

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: intelligence, to look at sort of summing up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And sort of the summing up is the issue here that we're...

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: One example is that the human genome, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So there was a lot of work on excitement about sequencing the human genome because the idea

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: would be that we'd be able to find genes that underlies diseases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But it turns out that...

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And it was a very reductionist idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: We figure out what all the parts are and then we would be able to figure out which parts

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: cause which things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But it turns out that the parts don't cause the things that we're interested in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It's like the interactions, it's the networks of these parts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And so that kind of reductionist approach didn't yield the explanation that we wanted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: What do you use the most beautiful complex system that you've encountered?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: The most beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: That you've been captivated by?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Is it sort of...

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I mean, for me, it's the simplest to be cellular automata.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Oh, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So I was very captivated by cellular automata and worked on cellular automata for several

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Do you find it amazing or is it surprising that such simple systems, such simple rules

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: in cellular automata can create sort of seemingly unlimited complexity?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Yeah, that was very surprising to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: How do you make sense of it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: How does that make you feel?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Is it just ultimately humbling or is there a hope to somehow leverage this into a deeper

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: understanding and even able to engineer things like intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It's definitely humbling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: How humbling in that...

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Also kind of awe-inspiring that it's that awe-inspiring part of mathematics that these

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: incredibly simple rules can produce this very beautiful, complex, hard to understand behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And it's mysterious and surprising still.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But exciting because it does give you kind of the hope that you might be able to engineer

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: complexity just from...

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: From simple rules from the beginnings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Can you briefly say what is the Santa Fe Institute, its history, its culture, its ideas, its

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: future?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So I've never...

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: As I mentioned to you, I've never been, but it's always been this, in my mind, this mystical

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: place where brilliant people study the edge of chaos.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Yeah, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So the Santa Fe Institute was started in 1984 and it was created by a group of scientists,

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: a lot of them from Los Alamos National Lab, which is about a 40-minute drive from the

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Santa Fe Institute.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: They were mostly physicists and chemists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But they were frustrated in their field because they felt that their field wasn't approaching

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: kind of big interdisciplinary questions like the kinds we've been talking about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And they wanted to have a place where people from different disciplines could work on these

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: big questions without sort of being siloed into physics, chemistry, biology, whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So they started this Institute and this was people like George Cowan, who was a chemist

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: in the Manhattan Project, and Nicholas Metropolis, a mathematician, physicist, Marie-Gail Mann,

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: a physicist, and there's some really big names here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Ken Arrow, a Nobel Prize-winning economist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And they started having these workshops.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And this whole enterprise kind of grew into this research institute that itself has been

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: kind of on the edge of chaos its whole life because it doesn't have a significant endowment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And it's just been kind of living on whatever funding it can raise through donations and

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: grants and however it can, business associates and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But it's a great place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It's a really fun place to go think about ideas that you wouldn't normally encounter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So Sean Carroll, so physicists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Yeah, he's on the external faculty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And you mentioned that there's, so there's some external faculty and there's people that

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: are-

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: A very small group of resident faculty, maybe about 10 who are there on five-year terms

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: that can sometimes get renewed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And then they have some post-docs and then they have this much larger, on the order of

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: 100, external faculty or people like me who come and visit for various periods of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So what do you think is the future of the Satterfield Institute?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And if people are interested, what's there in terms of the public interaction or students

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: or so on that could be a possible interaction with the Satterfield Institute or its ideas?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: and you do projects and people really like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Watching.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Douglas Haustader, author of Ghetto Escherbach was your PhD advisor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: He mentioned a couple of times and collaborator.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Do you have any favorite lessons or memories from your time working with him that continues

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: to this day, I guess, but just even looking back throughout your time working with him?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So one of the things he taught me was that when you're looking at a complex problem,

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: to idealize it as much as possible, to try and figure out what is the essence of this

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And this is how the copycat program came into being was by taking analogy making and saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: how can we make this as idealized as possible but still retain really the important things

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: we want to study?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And that's really been a core theme of my research, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And I continue to try and do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And it's really very much kind of physics inspired.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Haustader was a PhD in physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: That was his background.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: This is like first principles kind of thinking like you're reduced to the most fundamental

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: aspect of the problem so that you can focus on solving that fundamental aspect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And in AI, people used to work in these micro worlds, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Like the blocks world was very early important area in AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And then that got criticized because they said, oh, you can't scale that to the real

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And so people started working on much more real world like problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: But now there's been kind of a return even to the blocks world itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: We've seen a lot of people who are trying to work on more of these very idealized problems

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: for things like natural language and common sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So that's an interesting evolution of those ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So perhaps the blocks world represents the fundamental challenges of the problem of intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: more than people realize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: It might, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Is there sort of when you look back at your body of work and your life, you've worked

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: in so many different fields.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Is there something that you're just really proud of in terms of ideas that you've gotten

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: a chance to explore, create yourself?

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: So I am really proud of my work on the CopyCat project.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I think it's really different from what almost everyone has done in AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: I think there's a lot of ideas there to be explored.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And I guess one of the happiest days of my life, aside from the births of my children,

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: was the birth of CopyCat when it actually started to be able to make really interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: analogies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And I remember that very clearly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: That was a very exciting time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: Well you kind of gave life an artificial system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: That's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: In terms of what people can interact, I saw there's like a, I think it's called MetaCat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: And there's a Python 3 implementation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: If people actually wanted to play around with it and actually get into it and study it and

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: maybe integrate into whether it's with deep learning or any other kind of work they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61

body.input: doing, what would you suggest they do to learn more about it and to take it forward in different

metadata.title: Podcast: Melanie Mitchell: Concepts, Analogies, Common Sense & Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #61
