body.input: This is the Lex Friedman podcast,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and here is my conversation with Risto McElinan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: If we ran the Earth experiment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: this fun little experiment we're on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: over and over and over and over a million times

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and watched the evolution of life as it pans out,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: how much variation in the outcomes of that evolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: do you think we would see?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Now, we should say that you are a computer scientist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: That's actually not such a bad question

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: for computer scientists,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: because we are building simulations of these things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and we are simulating evolution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and that's a difficult question to answer in biology,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but we can build a computational model

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and run it million times and actually answer that question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: How much variation do we see when we simulate it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And that's a little bit beyond what we can do today,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but I think that we will see some regularities,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and it took evolution also a really long time

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: to get started, and then things accelerated really fast

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: towards the end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: But there are things that need to be discovered,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and they probably will be over and over again,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: like manipulation of objects, opposable thumbs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and also some way to communicate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: maybe orally, like when you have speech,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: it might be some other kind of sounds, and decision-making,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but also vision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Eye has evolved many times,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: various vision systems have evolved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So we would see those kinds of solutions, I believe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: emerge over and over again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: They may look a little different,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but they get the job done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: The really interesting question is would we have primates?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Would we have humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Or something that resembles humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And would that be an apex of evolution after a while?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: We don't know where we're going from here,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but we certainly see a lot of tool use,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and building our, constructing our environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So I think that we will get that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: We get some evolution producing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: some agents that can do that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: manipulate the environment and build.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: What do you think is special about humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: If you were running the simulation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and you observe humans emerge,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: like these tool makers, they start a fire,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and all this stuff, start running around,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: building buildings, and then running for president,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and all those kinds of things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: what would be, how would you detect that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Because you're really busy as the creator

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: of this evolutionary system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: so you don't have much time to observe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: like detect if any cool stuff came up, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: How would you detect humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Well, you are running the simulation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: so you also put in visualization

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and measurement techniques there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So if you are looking for certain things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: like communication, you'll have detectors to find out

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: whether that's happening, even if it's a lot simulation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And I think that that's what we would do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: We know roughly what we want,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: intelligent agents that communicate, cooperate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: manipulate, and we would build detections

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and visualizations of those processes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Yeah, and there's a lot of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: we'd have to run it many times,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and we have plenty of time to figure out

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: how we detect the interesting things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: But also, I think we do have to run it many times

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: because we don't quite know what shape those will take,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and our detectors may not be perfect for them

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: to begin with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Well, that seems really difficult to build a detector

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: of intelligent or intelligent communication.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Sort of, if we take an alien perspective, observing Earth,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: are you sure that they would be able to detect humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: as the special thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Wouldn't they be already curious about other things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: There's way more insects by body mass, I think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: than humans by far, and colonies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Obviously, dolphins is the most intelligent creature

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: on Earth, we all know this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So it could be the dolphins that they detect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: It could be the rockets that we seem to be launching.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: That could be the intelligent creature they detect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: It could be some other trees.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Trees have been here a long time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: I just learned that sharks have been here

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: 400 million years, and that's longer than trees

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: have been here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So maybe it's the sharks, they go by age.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: There's a persistent thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: If you survive long enough, especially through

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: the mass extinctions, that could be the thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: your detector is detecting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Humans have been here for a very short time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and we're just creating a lot of pollution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but so is other creatures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Do you think you would be able to detect humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: How would you go about detecting,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: in that computational sense, maybe we can leave humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: behind, in the computational sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: detect interesting things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Do you basically have to have a strict objective function

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: by which you measure the performance of a system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: or can you find curiosities and interesting things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Yeah, well, I think the first measurement would be

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: to detect how much of an effect you can have

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: in your environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So if you look around, we have cities,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and that is constructed environments,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and that's where a lot of people live, most people live.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So that would be a good sign of intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: that you don't just live in an environment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but you construct it to your liking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And that's something pretty unique.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: I mean, certainly birds build nests,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but they don't build quite cities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Termites build mounds and hives and things like that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but the complexity of the human construction cities,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: I think, would stand out, even to an external observer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Of course, that's what a human would say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Yeah, and you can certainly say that sharks are really smart

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: because they've been around so long,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and they haven't destroyed their environment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: which humans are about to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: which is not a very smart thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: But we'll get over it, I believe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And we can get over it by doing some construction

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: that actually is benign, and maybe even enhances

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: the resilience of nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So you mentioned the simulation that we run over and over

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: might start, it's a slow start.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So do you think how unlikely, first of all,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: I don't know if you think about this kind of stuff,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but how unlikely is step number zero,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: which is the springing up, like the origin of life on Earth?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And second, how unlikely is the,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: anything interesting happening beyond that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Sort of like the start that creates

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Success comes from mutation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Comes from using statistics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: It's like the rest of machine learning based on statistics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: We use similar tools to guide evolution computation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And in that sense, it has diverged a bit

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: from biological evolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And that's one of the things I think we could look

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: at again, having a weaker selection, more crossover,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: large populations, more time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and maybe a different kind of creativity

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: would come out of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: We are very impatient in evolution computation today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: We want answers right now, right, quickly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And if somebody doesn't perform, kill it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And biological evolution doesn't work quite that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And-

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: More patient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Yes, much more patient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So I guess we need to add some kind of mating,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: some kind of like dating mechanisms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: like marriage may be in there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So into our algorithms to improve the combination mechanism

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: as opposed to all mutation doing all of the work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Yeah, and many ways of being successful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Usually in evolution computation, we have one goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Play this game really well compared to others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: But in biology, there are many ways of being successful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: You can build niches, you can be stronger, faster, larger,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: or smarter, or eat this or eat that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So there are many ways to solve the same problem of survival.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And that then breeds creativity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And it allows more exploration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And eventually you get solutions

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: that are perhaps more creative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Rather than trying to go from initial population directly

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: or more or less directly to your maximum fitness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: as which you measure as just one metric.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So in a broad sense, before we talk about new evolution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: do you see evolutionary computation

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: as more effective than deep learning in certain contexts?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Machine learning, broadly speaking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Maybe even supervised machine learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: I don't know if you wanna draw any kind of lines

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and distinctions and borders where they rub up

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: against each other kind of thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: where one is more effective than the other

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: in the current state of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Yes, of course they are very different

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and they address different kinds of problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And the deep learning has been really successful

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: in domains where we have a lot of data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And that means not just data about situations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but also what the right answers were.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So labeled examples.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Or they might be predictions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: maybe weather prediction where the data itself

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: becomes labeled what happened, what the weather was today

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and what it will be tomorrow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So they are very effective,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: deep learning methods on that kind of tasks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: But there are other kinds of tasks

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: where we don't really know what the right answer is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Game playing, for instance,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but many robotics tasks and actions in the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: decision making, and actual practical applications

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: like treatments and healthcare,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: or investment in stock market.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Many tasks are like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: We don't know and we'll never know

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: what the optimal answers were.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And there you need different kinds of approaches.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Reinforcement learning is one of those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Reinforcement learning comes from biology as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Agents learn during their lifetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: They eat berries and sometimes they get sick

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and then they don't and get stronger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And then that's how you learn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And evolution is also a mechanism like that

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: by the different timescale because you have a population,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: not an individual during its lifetime,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but an entire population as a whole

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and discover what works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And there you can afford individuals that don't work out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: They will ask, everybody dies and you have a next generation

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and it will be better than the previous one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So that's the big difference between these methods.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: They apply to different kinds of problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And in particular, there's often a comparison

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: that's kind of interesting and important

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: between reinforcement learning and evolutionary computation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And initially reinforcement learning was about individual

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: learning during their lifetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And evolution is more engineering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: You don't care about the lifetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: You don't care about all the individuals that are tested.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: You only care about the final result.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: The last one, the best candidate that evolution produced.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: In that sense, they also apply

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: to different kinds of problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And now that boundary is starting to blur a bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: You can use evolution as an online method

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and reinforcement learning to create engineering solutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: But that's still roughly the distinction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And from the point of view of what algorithm you wanna use,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: if you have something where there is a cost for every trial,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: reinforcement learning might be your choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Now, if you have a domain where you can use a surrogate

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: perhaps, so you don't have much of a cost for trial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And you want to have surprises.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: You want to explore more broadly

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: than this population-based method

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: is perhaps a better choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Because you can try things out that you wouldn't afford

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: when you're doing reinforcement learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: There's very few things as entertaining

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: as watching either evolution computation

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: or reinforcement learning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: teaching a simulated robot to walk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Maybe there's a higher level question

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: that could be asked here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: But do you find this whole space of applications

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: in the robotics interesting for evolution computation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Yeah, yeah, very much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And indeed there are fascinating videos of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And that's actually one of the examples

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: where you can contrast the difference.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So between reinforcement learning and evolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Yes, so if you have a reinforcement learning agent,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: it tries to be conservative

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: because it wants to walk as long as possible and be stable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: But if you have evolution computation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: it can afford these agents that go haywire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: They fall flat on their face and they take a step

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and then they jump and then again fall flat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And eventually what comes out of that

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: is something like a falling that's controlled.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: You take another step, another step,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and you no longer fall.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Instead you run, you go fast.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So that's a way of discovering something

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: that's hard to discover step by step incrementally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Because you can afford these evolutionists dead ends,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: although they are not entirely dead ends

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: in the sense that they can serve as stepping stones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: When you take two of those, put them together,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: you get something that works even better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And that is a great example of this kind of discovery.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Yeah, learning to walk is fascinating.

body.input: There's a community of folks who just,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: that the discovery of a good solution

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: sometimes requires a leap of faith and patience

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and all those kinds of things.

body.input: I wonder what other spaces were yet to discover

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: those kinds of things in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Yeah, and another interesting direction is

body.input: if you're collaborating to pick up an object,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: you have to figure out is the human,

body.input: there's a few discrete states that the human could be in,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: you have to predict that by observing the human,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and that seems like a machine learning problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: to figure out what's the human up to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: It's not as simple as sort of planning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: You have to really have a model

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: of what they're thinking about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and what's the motivation behind the movement of the arm.

body.input: Here we are talking about relatively simple

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: also to predict what the people are going to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: are they just trying to get somewhere?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: But even higher level, I mean you are predicting

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And that takes a lot more information,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but it allows you to then predict their actions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: what choices they might make.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So how does evolutionary computation apply

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: to the world of neural networks?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Because I've seen quite a bit of work from you and others

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: in the world of neural evolution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: so maybe first can you say what is this field?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Yeah, neural evolution is a combination of neural networks

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and evolutionary computation in many different forms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but the early versions were simply using evolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: as a way to construct a neural network,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: instead of say, stochastic gradient descent

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: or backpropagation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Because evolution can evolve these parameters,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: weight values in a neural network,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: just like any other string of numbers, you can do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And that's useful because some cases you don't have

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: those targets that you need to backpropagate from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And it might be an agent that's running a maze

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: or a robot playing a game or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: You don't, again, you don't know what the right answer is

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: so you don't have backprop,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but this way you can still evolve a neural net.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And neural networks are really good at these tasks

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: because they recognize patterns

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and they generalize interpolate between known situations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So you want to have a neural network in such a task,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: even if you don't have the supervised targets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So that's a reason and that's a solution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And also more recently now when we have

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: all this deep learning literature,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: it turns out that we can use evolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: to optimize many aspects of those designs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: The deep learning architectures have become so complex

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: that there's little hope for us little humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: to understand their complexity

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and what actually makes a good design.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And now we can use evolution to give that design for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And it might mean optimizing hyperparameters,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: like the depth of layers and so on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: or the topology of the network,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: how many layers, how they're connected,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but also other aspects like what activation functions

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: you use where in the network during the learning process,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: or what loss function you use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: You can generate that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Even data augmentation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: all the different aspects of the design

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: of deep learning experiments could be optimized that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So that's an interaction between two mechanisms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: But there's also, when we get more into cognitive science

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and the topics that we've been talking about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: you could have learning mechanisms at two level timescales.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So you do have an evolution

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: that gives you baby neural networks

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: that then learn during their lifetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And you have this interaction of two timescales.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And I think that can potentially be really powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Now, in biology, we are not born with all our faculties.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: We have to learn.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: We have a developmental period.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: In humans, it's really long.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And most animals have something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And probably the reason is that evolution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: or DNA is not detailed enough

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: or plentiful enough to describe them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: We can't describe how to set the brain up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: But evolution can decide on a starting point

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and then have a learning algorithm

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: that will construct the final product.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And this interaction of intelligent,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: well, evolution that has produced a good starting point

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: for the specific purpose of learning from it

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: with the interaction with the environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: That can be a really powerful mechanism

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: for constructing brains and constructing behaviors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: I like how you walk back from intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So optimize starting point maybe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: There's a lot of fascinating things to ask here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And this is basically this dance between neural networks

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and evolution and computation

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: to where you're optimizing,

body.input: or throughout the history of machine learning

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Maybe there's a few components you're playing with,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but to grow in your own network, essentially,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: the way you grow in their organisms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: really fascinating space.

body.input: And maybe what kind of neural networks are more amenable

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: Is there some architectures that are friendlier than others?

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And is this just a fun, small scale set of experiments

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: I think we can and most of the work up to now

body.input: is taking architectures that already exist

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And you can totally do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: that humans had come up with, or your venials and others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: But that's starting from a point that humans have produced

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: but we could do something more general.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: It doesn't have to be that kind of network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: The hard part is just a couple of challenges.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: One of them is to define the search base.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: And the space is just really, really big.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: So you have to somehow constrain it

body.input: and have some hunch of what will work

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: because otherwise everything is possible.

body.input: And another challenge is that in order to evaluate

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: how good your design is, you have to train it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and all that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Risto Miikkulainen: Neuroevolution and Evolutionary Computation | Lex Fridman Podcast #177

body.input: and we're making progress on all those fronts.

body.input: So yes, there are certain architectures

body.input: but also I think we can create our own architecture

body.input: And now, dear friends, here's Jack Barsky.

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That nobody knows very much about.

body.input: When I was in the KGB, I had no idea that there was military intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Interesting.

body.input: Yeah, that's always the question.

body.input: but at the same time, you want it to be shrouded in complete mystery.

body.input: KGB being probably one of, if not the most famous,

body.input: It was founded in 1954 after the death of Stalin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: In writing your book, you looked back at the predecessors of the history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Is there some way in which the KGB is grounded in the culture, the spirit, the soul of its predecessors?

body.input: Oh, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They just changed names and they changed personnel rather frequently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That had something to do with Stalin's paranoia from between 1923.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I don't remember what, I think it may have been the NKVD at that time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It started as a Chikha and then it became the GPU, the NKVD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's three or four letter words.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes, but with those name changes, you also had changes at the top.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Between 1923 and 1953 when Stalin died, that is 30 years, they had eight heads of intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Of those eight, six were executed when they were replaced.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's an indication that this was an organization that ate itself from the inside.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The Soviet Union was the only dictatorship in history that did not rest its powers on the military.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They rested its powers on the intelligence apparatus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That thing was unstable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You know where that leads. Eventually, if you rest your power on something that is made out of bricks that don't hold a lot of load, it will fall apart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: On sand. Why was it unstable, would you say? What of human nature makes it unstable?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's the paranoia. Stalin was always worried about the most powerful people coming after him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He proactively killed off heads of the KGB.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He had this great purge where he got rid of a lot of his generals, really capable generals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That cost him dearly when World War II started because he started off with a force that wasn't as capable as it could have been.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Was it paranoia at all levels?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I believe so. I believe so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It comes from the top.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: If the top doesn't trust you, you always have to worry about your peers snitching on you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I think we have a very similar situation in Russia today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: In this kind of atmosphere, the truth will never get to the top.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So no matter what moral rules the organization operates under, trust is fundamental to its competence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Absolutely. I want to extend this to my own existence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: This is kind of strange. It's almost dichotomous because I was running around lying to everybody.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I couldn't fundamentally be trusted, but the relationship that I had with the KGB was based on trust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: If they don't trust me, they don't send me out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There were hints about how long my assignment would be, so 10 to 12 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Love always screws up your employment competence.

body.input: You're absolutely right.
