body.input: which you've got to worry about them if you defect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Because in the past, the KGB would go after family ruthlessly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Including perhaps violence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: This is a hard question about the KGB because it's one of the most ruthless organizations, but in general.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Are there lines, KGB agents at every level of the hierarchy that they would not cross?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Political, legal, ethical, or does anything go to achieve the goal?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I was only in touch with two types of agents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: One were the technical experts, the ones that taught me tradecraft.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They were engineers and they were in charge of the secret writing and the Morse code,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: shortwave radio reception, decryption, encryption, and that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Those were just doing their job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the others, the ones that trained me, that prepared me for life in the United States,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: they were nice people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They were elegant people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I don't think they would not fit into the stereotype of the ruthless gun carrying agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Is it possible that you would not be aware of the parts of the KGB?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I mean, it's very modular.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's possible that you're not aware of the parts of the KGB that are the quote unquote muscle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Oh, I didn't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I would find out afterwards after I retired and started doing some research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I had no clue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So you're kind of operating in a bubble.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Very much so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I mean, this is what the KGB did really, really well, compartmentalization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that was based on the communist movement while it was still underground.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The cells were very small.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So that maybe there were three, four members in one cell that knew one another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then they had a liaison to another cell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The bottom line is if you got one of those folks were caught,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: they could maybe betray four people or three, something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the KGB continued with that tradition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I have reason to believe that my handler, the person in Moscow that sort of directed me

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and made decisions what to do and where to go, never met me personally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There's no reason to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And this actually was a big advantage over other intelligence services

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: because you look at what the CIA does, everybody blabs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There's a lot of leaks coming out of American intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I don't think there's as many leaks coming out of the Mossad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Strong words from Jack Barsky, by the way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That is a question I want to ask a little more systematically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Is there something unique about the KGB compared to the other intelligence agencies?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Let's talk British intelligence, MI6, Mossad, CIA.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Are there unique cultures, spirits, souls of the different organizations

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that maybe somehow connect to the structures of government,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: connect maybe the values of the people, those kinds of things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I believe we were all pretty much strong believers in communism in the future of the world being...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: In KGB.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes. I think that unified us to a large degree, even the technicians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It wasn't something like, yeah, yeah, the parents believe this thing, but we know the truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You really believe the story of communism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Absolutely did. And you need to look at the timeframe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The Soviet Union after World War II made quite a bit of progress in influencing the Third World.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I still remember when I was in middle school, we had a map, the map of the world, and it was color coded.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So red was communism, that was the Soviet Union and the Eastern States, and then blue was capitalism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then we had green, which were the Third World countries, and the green slowly turned pink

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: because a lot of Third World governments, like I'm looking at Angola, I'm looking at Vietnam,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: a lot of these countries were very sympathetic to the Soviet Union.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And so we sort of knew that this would go on like that, and eventually we would take over

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and pretty much overtake, that was the myth, overtake the United States, not only militarily,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but also in terms of industrial production and so forth. That was a stupid pipe dream.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The military, it was a standoff, as we know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, stupid pipe dream. Hitler had a stupid pipe dream that he executed exceptionally effectively on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: If not for a handful of military mistakes, the world could look very different today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The biggest one being invading the Soviet Union, particularly at the time that he did it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: because he ran into the same thing that Napoleon ran into General Winter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, within, so Operation Barbarossa, within that, he could have made different decisions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: For example, attacking, skipping Kiev and attacking Moscow directly, overthrowing the government.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So marching, I guess that that would be learning lessons from Napoleon as opposed to

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: a different kind of distribution of forces and then getting bogged down in the winter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But the point is these ambitions sometimes do, you know, the ambitions of empires sometimes do materialize

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: in the growth and the building and the establishment of those empires.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And those empires write the history books in such a way that we don't think of them as empires,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: or we certainly don't think of them as the bad guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They write the history books, therefore they're the good guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And right now, America has effectively written the book about the good guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I happen to believe that book, but it's, we should be humbled and open-minded to realize that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that is in fact what is happening, is effective empires write the history books and tell us stories

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and tell us propaganda and tell us narratives that we believe because we are human beings

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and we love to get together and believe ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: We love to dream of a beautiful world and try to build that beautiful world together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: In the United States, that's a beautiful world, the freedom of respect of human rights,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: of all men are created equal, pursuit of happiness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You know, it always sounds good if you look at what the dream of communism is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: it sure as heck in its words, on the surface, sounds good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Respect for the workers, the working class, the lower classes that have been trodden on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that have been stolen from by the powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They deserve to have the money, the power, the respect that they have earned through their hard work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Sounds great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And everybody gets along and we just have to, you know, all men are wonderful people

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and if they go bad, it has something to do with the fact that they have been oppressed, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that dream just never worked out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And even it is when you think about it, and I didn't think about it, when you're young,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: you just emotionally, you accept it, but when you think about it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: somehow that new wonderful organization has to organize itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Even though Lenin predicted that the state eventually would go away,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: well how does it work? Then you have like anarchy, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You have to have an organization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the only way to really organize a large number of people is with a hierarchy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So, and who gets to the top?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The ones that want to go to the top, the ones that believe in themselves,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: the ones that know better than everybody else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And once you have that hierarchy established, there is no guarantee that it won't go bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And actually when you look at history, every such hierarchy has gone bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You know, you look at Cuba for instance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I believe Fidel Castro was an honest revolutionary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I do believe that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And so what did Cuba turn into?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, there's something about, and you speak about Vladimir Putin in this way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but let's step away from that for a second.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Is there something about being an honest revolutionary that wants to do good for their country?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And you start to believe that you know better than everyone else how to do good in the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And you very well might first, but then somehow that grows into a distortion field

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: where you keep believing you know what's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And all the people who disagree with you, you stop seeing them as having a point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You instead see them as like evil manipulators of the truth

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that are actually trying to hurt people for their own greed, for their own power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And you will protect the people because you know what's good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: In the case of Stalin, I mean, I don't know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but it seems like he really believed that communism would bring about a much better world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I mean, there was a sense that you have to crack a few eggs to make an omelet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: This idea that sacrifice is necessary to bring about a greater world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then the other aspect is sort of ruling by terror,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: creating terrorism, justified political mechanism to achieve a better world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So it wasn't, I mean, perhaps he had to do that to be able to sleep at night with the atrocities he's committing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I think he believed he will bring about a better world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And by the way, the terror didn't start with Stalin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It started right after the Bolsheviks took over when Lenin told Mr. Jouzinski,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Kamenadze Jouzinski, to build the Chekhov and then execute the, this is what he called it, the Red Terror.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So at the birth of the Soviet Union, there was already terror and it was deliberate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And it also was, it wasn't just focused on the enemies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was focused on whoever you didn't like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There was no rule of law. There was no court cases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: People were just pulled out of their apartments and shot on sight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And this was done by revolutionaries who were convinced that eventually,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: these sacrifices had to be made and eventually that would lead to a much better planet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the populace believed this too, that those sacrifices, in part.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: This is such a dark thing about dictatorships is you believe it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but you're also too afraid to question your beliefs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Like you're not directly afraid, but almost like, I don't know what that is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's almost like a subconscious fear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Like don't, there's a dark room with a locked door. Don't look in that door.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Don't check that door.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And there's something about the United States that says, especially modern culture,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: is that go to that door first and sort of question everything kind of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's the power of the freedom of speech and the freedom of the press,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but you can get almost become too critical and too cynical of your own culture in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So there's a balance to strike, of course, but man, if that's,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: if communism is not a lesson of human nature, I don't know what is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but you believed without thinking too much about it, you believe in the story of communism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: What did you see just, you know, I came from the Soviet Union.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: What did you maybe feel that's right and good about communism, about the vision of communism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Do you remember like?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I think the biggest impetus in me believing in communism was that the communists,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: when just before Hitler took over, the communists were the only force in Germany

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that fought the Nazis in the streets. And that's a historic truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And communists were hunted down by the Nazis, killed, put in concentration camps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And so what we knew, what we were taught, and I think that was a huge unforced error

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: by the Western countries, particularly the United States,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that there were ex-Nazis in the government in West Germany.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the most famous one was Reinhard Gehlen, who was the general in charge of

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: the intelligence on the Eastern Front under Hitler.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And when the Allied won the war, it was decided that Gehlen was too important

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: with his knowledge of the, and his organization was too important to not use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So he was co-opted by the CIA and eventually wound up being the head of the Bundesnachrichtendienst,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: the CIA of West Germany. That gave us, us when I say us, you know, the East German party,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: a huge propaganda victory. I wanted to, because the emotional aspect of this was as follows.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: When we, we were in, when juniors in high school, and in those days,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: when you, you were only allowed to go to high school if you were in the top 10% of students, okay?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So this was going to be the next set of ruling elite in the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: We were sent, we were required to visit a concentration camp.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And if you know what we as 17 year olds were made to look at, it was gut wrenching.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: How can man do something like that to man? Piles of corpses, lampshades made out of human skin

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: because that skin had tattoos on them and a shrunken head, so heads like the size of my fist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I mean, the girls all cried and it would have made a huge impression.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that was the Nazis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the communists defeated the Nazis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Here's one example. There was a German communist who went underground when Hitler took over

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I forgot exactly what it was, but it came to Moscow and Stalin totally ignored it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And when Sorge was captured by the Japanese, the Soviet Union denied that he was one of theirs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: especially when you become more and more powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then the intelligence apparatus is probably giving you information you don't like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's often negative information about...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Basically, information that says that the decisions you made in the past are not great decisions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and that's a difficult truth to deal with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So in the modern times, if we hop around briefly, Vladimir Putin has been not happy with the intelligence of the FSB,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But I guess I suppose the same story happens there throughout history as a paranoia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I give you an example that comes from a very reliable source,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and that my best German friend worked as a chemist in the Stasi, East German intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And he eventually rose to the rank of major and was in charge of the forgery department.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He was aware that there was intelligence that was collected. The Stasi was really good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the central committee of the party, the decision makers, ignored it because it didn't quite fit in their worldview.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It didn't quite fit into their plans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And one delicious thing that I just want to add on to this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's nevertheless called democratic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Nice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Because where I grew up, I could walk to the Neise River, which was the border with Poland,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and it was only about an hour by bus to get to the Czech border, so that's why I'm a mix.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So, okay, so East Germany after the war was communist, socialist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and then the West Germany was representing the Western world with democracy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And what the United States did, this was really, really very forward-looking, very strategic, the Marshall Plan,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: to rebuild the economy in the West as compared to what the Soviet Union did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Whatever they hadn't destroyed on the way in, they took with them on the way out for reparations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: because they had every right to do that, but it was not a good idea because East Germany was always behind

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: in economic development to their Western counterpart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So when you were young, as today, but when you were young, you were clearly an exceptional student.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It taught me only in hindsight. At the time, I was just like, my God, I was head over heels in love.

body.input: I was 16 years old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They were not capable of doing evil things. They were beautiful and they had to be adored.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that too was magical for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Oh my God, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And literally, I dedicated. That's when I started studying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So you're going to have to work hard in this world to be somebody that could be adored by those you love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that's a strong part of who you are, and therefore it will also be a part of directing your life trajectory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Oh my God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then you kind of change that, you shape it and you give that love in deeper, more profound ways to future people.
