metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You document your time as a KGB spy before, during, and after.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Can you tell the story of when you first were contacted by the KGB,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and just how you were invited, the offer to join was made?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, it was a big surprise and I never thought of myself as a potential agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I was going to be a tenured professor and join the ruling elite because in Europe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: tenured professors are few.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's not like in the United States, anybody who teaches at colleges has a title of professor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Easy now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's not a criticism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So we should also clarify that, tenured professor or not,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: it is a very prestigious position throughout history of Europe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I would say, especially communists, I don't actually know the full landscape of the respect,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but at least in the Soviet Union where I grew up, it's a prestigious position.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Absolutely was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the town of Yenna had about 100,000 people live there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And it's a wild guess, but maybe 30 tenured professors,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and they were part of the ruling elite.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I was trying to do as much as I can to live the good life, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You know, have access to things that are nice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, but I think the powerful thing about being a professor in that context of East Germany is the prestige.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the feeling of superiority.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I was full of myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: When you are the best of the best.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And in my third year I received a scholarship, the Karl Marx Scholarship,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that was limited to 100 concurrent recipients in the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So my God, I was full of myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I believed in myself, hook, line and sinker.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I was also, I got a lot of accolades from teachers and fellow students.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They were feeding the ego.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I mean, you have to believe in yourself often when you are young to truly excel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And you sure as heck did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But you know, as a balance you need a mentor, somebody who puts things in perspective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I didn't have one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: My father was a nonentity and nobody else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They all looked up to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I was an up and coming guy, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So there is no father figure that put you in your place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Not at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I give you one extreme example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was down the road when I fathered a child out of wedlock.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That was in my fifth year, I believe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The Communist Party in East Germany was very moralistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: If you did that, they would have a talk with you and give you whatever, severe reprimand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Nobody even mentioned a word about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So yeah, this is how this ego gets nurtured.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But anyway, getting back to how the KGB came in contact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So they most likely got knowledge of me by looking at Stasi records.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: What's Stasi?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Oh, that was East German secret police, Staatssicherheit, security for the state.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There's that word security again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And they pretty much kept a record on everybody in the country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And so when you look through this, and this is what the KGB was looking for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They were looking for candidates, particularly for this kind of job that they had in mind for me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: candidates who were not in their mid-20s, who were not fully developed yet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but mature enough to get there and still young enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Because at that level of maturity you can test whether they can handle this kind of job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes, absolutely right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And one day I got a knock on my door and my dorm room door was on a Saturday.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And they knew that I was by myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: How did they know it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I pieced this together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: We had an exchange student from the Soviet Union and he was next door to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And he befriended me, so he got to know me a little bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the pattern was that my roommate would always go home for the weekend.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And of course they also knew which door to knock on even though there were no name plates.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Somebody knocks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I knew it was a stranger because if it had been a student,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: the pattern was that we would knock on the door and then go in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: We wouldn't wait for somebody to let us in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I waited for 10 seconds and he didn't come in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I knew that it was a stranger and I said, come on in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then came a person who spoke fluent German.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So that was not a KGB guy, it was a collaborator.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And so he started making a bunch of small talk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He called himself as a representative of Carl Zeiss Jena, which was the optics company

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that made really, really good optical instruments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was one of the best in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So it's like the super prestigious company in that place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Right. And he said that he was a representative of that company.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And he would just want to find out what my plans were after graduating from college.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And at that point I knew he wasn't from Carl Zeiss Jena

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: because in those days there was no recruitment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: When you were done, if you were in the top 10% of the graduates,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: you would most likely pick to stay and get a doctorate, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the rest of them were assigned. You had no choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So that guy was an idiot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He didn't know the basics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You interviewed him a little bit to understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Oh, sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Like, feel out, is this guy full of shit?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Because yeah, it's a stranger showing up to you, don't you remember?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I knew that at that point I knew he was Stasi, which is wrong,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but it doesn't matter because he was German and I had no idea that the KGB would be involved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So sorry to pause briefly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Did you have a sense, did people know that there's a Stasi type of organization,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that there is a large number of people doing this kind of work in East Germany

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: in order for you to make that guess?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, we knew that the Stasi existed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: We even had our James Bond, we had a series called The Invisible Visor

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: where a Stasi employee in East Germany would go into West Germany and hunt down Nazis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So yes, the Stasi was known to be there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And admired in part? Or feared? Or both?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I thought they were necessary and I admired them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: James Bond.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes, the reason I did so, because I had no information to the contrary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I never knew anybody personally or even somewhat removed

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: who was followed by the Stasi, was put in jail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I had no clue. I had no clue that they did a lot of damage

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: or that they were doing a lot of surveillance of the East German population

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: the same way the KGB did for the Soviet Union.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So for me to be talking to somebody from the Stasi, it raised my interest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I was curious what comes next because I sort of knew something interesting would be coming at me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I had no other thoughts about that at that point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So when he was finally, when he went for the kill by reversing himself, he said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: you know, I got to tell you that I really am not from Karlsruhe, you know, I'm from the government.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Okay, thank you for pointing that out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then he asked this question. He said, can you imagine to one day work for the government?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And so I gave a pretty clever answer. I said, yes, but not as a chemist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I answered the question that he didn't ask. I helped him out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So we made an arrangement to meet for lunch, which in Germany is the main meal,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: at the number one restaurant in Jena. I still remember what I ate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: What was that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Rum steak with butter on top and french fries was my favorite.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Anyway, so when I get to the restaurant, I saw this fellow sitting in the back there at the table

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and there was another person at the table.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I was a little bit hesitant because in those days, it was not unusual for perfect strangers to share a table

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: because I wouldn't have enough tables and chairs and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I didn't know if I could approach him, but he got up and came to me and he took me to the table

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and he said, I want to introduce Herman. We work with our Soviet comrades.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Aha, KGB. And then he disappeared. He says, I got something else to do. I never knew his name.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He just handed me over to the KGB.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: What was the relationship between the KGB and the Stasi's?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: As collaborators, close collaborators or just distant associates?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They were pretty close collaborators. As I told you that they bought forged documents that the Germans made

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: because the Germans were better at forgery.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They also exchanged information, but they didn't trust each other 100%.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I tell you why I know that. So they recruited me to send me to West Germany.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: As I already said, East Germany had a thousand agents over there. Why would they want to have their own?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah. Okay. This is a fascinating internal and external dynamic of distrust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Okay. So there you are welcomed by the KGB. When did the offer, the invite come?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, that took a while. So Herman and I had an unofficial relationship for about a year and a half.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I would meet him once a week, once every two weeks, initially in his car,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but then he took me to a conspirational flat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was an apartment that was occupied by a party member, a lady, single lady.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: When we came in, she would leave. She left us tea and cookies, and then we could freely talk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He also at that time gave me some West German literature magazines to read, which was of course forbidden.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I'm starting to feel somewhat special.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And as we were talking about what they had in mind for me in general,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I knew that I was going to be even more special because I would be above the law.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I would operate outside the law of the countries I would go to as well as East Germany, because you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: the magazines, and eventually when I joined up, they told me I had better watch West German television,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: which was also not explicitly prohibited, but it was something that could get you in trouble.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So on many levels, you're super special. You're the James Bond.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes, yes, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So what was that recruitment testing process like, testing whether you have what it takes to be a KGB agent?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: First of all, we had very in-depth talks, Herman and I, about life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I still am very honest in sharing my feelings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Philosophical or personal?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Personal. I even told him that I was shy around the girls.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He was giving you relationship advice or what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So what was the dynamic? Can you tell me, was it a father, son?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: No, older brother. Older brother.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, he was maybe in his early to mid-30s, and I was maybe 10 years younger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And what languages did he speak?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He spoke German pretty well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But he's originally from Russia?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, with a Russian accent. So I got in trouble one time with him when I asked him,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: is your real name German? He didn't like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He didn't like it. Was he good with girls?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: No, I remember what he told me. He says, you've got to understand one thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They're looking for guys too. That's all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Girls are looking for guys too. It's a competitive game.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Don't worry about it. Don't be so shy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So that little flame of love that we talked about in all the shapes that it takes in our life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: did he talk to you about that, that that could be taken advantage of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that that could be used, or was it implied?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, but it was not very focused, not in great detail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So we talked about personal stuff and dislikes. He gave me tasks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: For instance, when my friend and I hitchhiked from East Germany all the way down to Bulgaria,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: he told me to write a report about it, what I saw.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So fundamentally, he wanted to see how well I can write and how well I can report, how well I observe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He also asked me to write some profiles about fellow students.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I don't believe that was for them to give him to the stasi.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was just like, how well do I characterize people?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's important when you're talking about when I was in the US, active in the US,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I operated as a spotter, so I did exactly that. I wrote profiles about people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He also gave me some tasks to do that were rather unpleasant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Like what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He would give me an address and a name of the people who lived at the address,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and he told me to go there, ring the doorbell,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and find out something about a relative who lived in West Germany.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That is undercover exploration, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So you make up a story and somehow win the confidence of your target to tell you something that you want to know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Did that come naturally to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: No, I hated it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The charisma involved? Which part did you hate?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, charisma, I think I didn't know that I had it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It took you some time to discover.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I always was and I still am to some degree a bit shy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I lost a lot of the shyness after moving to the South here in the United States because you don't have to be shy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You can let your love shine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's exactly right. Anyway, I hated doing that, but I did it well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I still remember, in those days I had a beard and I rang the bell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Tall, handsome fellow?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, and I looked the part, I said I'm a sociology student and I'm doing a survey,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and I asked a whole bunch of questions, would you like to answer the questions?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: No problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then I directed the conversation to the lady's private life and she actually gave me information,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: she volunteered information that I wanted to know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I did well and the other one that I didn't like, but I also did well with,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: when Herman drove me around the city and showed me a building and he said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: find out what organization is in there, what they do, maybe get to know some people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and I did that pretty well also.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You have to be inventive to come up with a cover story and I've always been quite inventive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I'm a storyteller at heart and I didn't know it then, but...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But there was still something unpleasant about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes, yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Which part was unpleasant?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The shyness and then I wasn't very comfortable lying, I became comfortable down the road,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but I was brutally honest and never hid anything of me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But over time you lose that uncomfortable feeling and you rationalize that you've got to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There's only one way, right? And you're serving a good cause.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So you were talking to Herman for a year and a half.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: A year and a half.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then how did that progress?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes. So he finally, I guess he sent a report to headquarters in Berlin

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and then he sent me on a three-week, quote-unquote, practice trip to Berlin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: This was the first time when I had a conspiratorial meeting where I had an address and a time

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and a code phrase and I met another agent. His name was Boris.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: These names were meaningless. They were all like cover names, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So what was the code and the meaning? Can you give a little more detail?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That code I don't remember.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Not the code, but like what do you mean by code?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I tell you the code we used when I met while I was active.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I would approach the other person who I thought may be the person I want to meet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: We both had something with us or on us to make us more likely to be the right person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I would ask him the following questions. Excuse me, I'm looking for Susan Green.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And he would answer, yes, you must be David. Stupid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: If I ask a stranger, they would look at me, how could I help you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So no, it's the wrong guy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's just a low probability that the right thing would be said.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Oh, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And it seems like a safe statement if it's not the right person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Exactly right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You'll just come off absurd or crazy or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You would have made a good secret agent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: No, I'm not. We'll discuss this. I'm dressed like one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Actually, yeah, were there any dress code?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: No, just fit in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Fit in, no matter what. And then be creative. Figure out ways to fit in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Right. So anyways, he gave me some tasks and since I had rented a room and a house,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: he gave me Western literature to read. And we spent time together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And there was a practice run to West Germany. Actually, there were two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that was very important. In hindsight, I figured that out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I traveled to West Germany, no, not to West Berlin, with an East German passport

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that was stamped that that individual was allowed to go to the West.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And there was a part of the border that was only guarded by Soviet troops.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that's where they smuggled me into West Germany. I got on the subway and then

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: appeared in West Berlin. No Americans, no Brits, no French knew that I had entered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Forged documents or not?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: No, no, this was an East German passport. It was real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Okay. So, and the first trip, all they wanted me to do is just walk around,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: smell the air, have a beer or whatever, and eat a sausage and then come back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The second trip, I had a task, very similar to the one that I had back in Jena,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: to ring the doorbell someplace and talk to some people. And that worked very well also.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I should mention that you talk about that, you know, eat a sausage, drink some beer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I suppose that's a good test too, to see how you behave under Western,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: like when first introduced to the Western culture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: This is why I might not make a good agent, is when I first came to the United States

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: in the supermarket, I liked bananas, as many bananas as I want to eat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That, I think that would break me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's a shock.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's a shock to have access to Western culture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You're getting very close to the reason they actually made me do these two practice trips.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: When I first emerged on West Berlin territory, I felt highly uncomfortable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That was the enemy, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I saw the cops everywhere, and even though those cops had like light blue uniforms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: they weren't standouts. So I was wondering if they knew that I had like KGB on my forehead.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So you were paranoid that they would know, they would see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I was scared, but I overcame that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So can we just linger on that? Because I suppose that's a natural,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: like if I give anybody on the street the mission to do the mission you had to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: is they would be paranoid. That's a natural human feeling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Am I being watched? Do they know?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Like if you try to steal something from a store, there's going to be a feeling like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: are they watching me? Are the cameras watching? Are the people watching me?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They all know that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So you have to be somehow rugged and robust to that kind of feeling and overcome it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes, exactly. And something very interesting happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: While I was being trained in Berlin, I met a classmate of mine from high school.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And he confided to me that he was recruited by the Stasi to go as a spy to West Germany.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And he also had this practice trip, and he peed in his pants.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He went back and told him, I can't do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Just from the terror, that paranoia?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Now, this guy's career was over. He had an engineering degree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He was a pretty smart guy. He was just for the rest of his life, and he's still alive, I believe,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: floating around and trading in model railroads and stuff like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You mean, do you think that experience broke him?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They wouldn't let him back in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Oh, I see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So it's a test that if you fail, you pay the price.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I had no idea that something bad would happen if I failed that test, but I didn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I didn't fail. So, and this led then to the offer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And Boris was happy with me, and he told his boss, who was most likely the head of the KGB in East Berlin,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and I had an appointment to meet- In East Germany.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes, in East Germany. Yeah, all of East Germany. That's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: An appointment to meet with him, and as we walk into the room, there was this huge desk,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and a little guy sitting behind it. Very, very, just like little and unimpressive. Nice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: A lot of paraphernalia, like, you know, I had a bust of Jadzinski on this desk,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and some paintings, Lenin and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But when the guy opened his mouth, he was like, whoa, huge psychological energy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He spoke only Russian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Now, and initially, he would, you know, start to bet with five minutes worth of propaganda,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: why we're doing what we're doing. I didn't need that. I understood most of it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but when I didn't understand, I asked Boris to translate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then he sprung it on me, and I was not prepared. He said, so what, are you in or not?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I was, no, I hadn't made up my mind. I wasn't expecting that would come.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I said to him, I'm not really trained. You know, there's a lot of things I need to learn,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and I came up with a couple of really stupid things. One, not so stupid, but the other one was,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I don't know why I said that. I said, for instance, I need to learn how to drive a car and to type

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: with a typewriter. And he got really annoyed, and he said, don't worry about it. We'll train you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But I got to tell you, we need people who are decisive. So you got until tomorrow noon

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: to give Boris your decision. That made for a sleepless night.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So what was going through your mind?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, I had, this was almost 50-50. I knew I was going to have a huge career, a good career.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I was on my way because I was already employed by the university as an assistant professor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So that career would be to become a professor, become a 10-year professor, be a world class.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes. Jena had become my hometown. I really loved the place. It was my oyster. And my family was my basketball team.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You loved playing basketball?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Oh, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So that's what you mean. Yeah, so this is home. This is home. This is where your love is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: This was home.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Did you understand that the choice involved leaving the home behind?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes. And the one thing I didn't have, the two things I didn't have, an emotional relationship with my mother.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I didn't have a steady girlfriend at the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I think Freud would have a lot to say about that. But yeah, go ahead. But the connection between those two,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I'm sure. By the way, my friend, Gunther, the one who worked for the Stasi, was also, the Stasi tried to recruit him as an agent,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but he had a love relationship at the time. And he said politely, no, I won't. I can't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So you didn't have, that's the one thing that really could have held you to this place is love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So you got the career on the one hand, my basketball team, the town that I would be part of the ruling elite of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then we had this great adventure and the ability to contribute to the victory, the worldwide victory of communism

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and stick it to the Nazis. And of course, the feeling that you're really special.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, James Bond. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The question, do I want to be a tenure professor or James Bond?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes. And that's as funny as that sounds, that was probably a difficult decision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was a difficult decision, but fundamentally it wasn't, and it wasn't my zeal to help the revolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was my, what they called, what the Stasi was looking for, the KGB was looking for in a character that they would send over a well controlled inclination to adventure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, James Bond, what are you going to say? And the love of women.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I was, yes, I got to put this in right here because I'm telling people I have two things in common with James Bond.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: These are my initials, JB, and I got the girl too, three times.
