metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I knew that there was trouble. My counter surveillance route didn't discover anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I kept on going. I was supposed to visit two more cities, and they were always one step behind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: What is interesting to me is that they didn't catch me on the way out. You have to show your passport to the airline.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I was known by name because I had to give that to the hotel, right? And I escaped.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They would have to keep you on a list, right? Yeah, that's interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But that requires a good computerized updated system to track that stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: This was Swiss Air. Well, you got lucky. Part of life is luck.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Other than that, the trip to Canada was a big success because it gave me the culture shock that I needed to not be blown out of the water when I get to the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So you hopped a few places in Canada and then Swiss Air.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I even had a relationship with a young lady.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: A French-Canadian, regular Canadian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: A French-Canadian. She gave me a book, Winnie the Pooh, because we went to see the movie.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Then she wrote the dedication, she says, to the nicest German I've ever met.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Was she lying? No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Speaking of spycraft, that led to a heartbreak too? No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That was sexual. I was not at that point ready to return to that old love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, I was already married in Germany. That woman I loved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: We should return to this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So Swiss Air, where did you land in the United States?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: When I came, where did I land? American Airlines, a flight from Mexico City to Toronto, but they made me de-plane in Chicago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I have no idea. I think it was over-engineering. That didn't make any sense to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Why can't a Canadian just take a flight from Mexico City?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: With this stopover, this kind of nonsense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, but okay. Nevertheless, that was it, and then you landed in Chicago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Tell me the story in America. What was the day-to-day life? Now you're a spy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: No, I've got to tell you another funny story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There are two things that happened that could have ended my career as a spy right then and there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I'm arriving in Chicago in the evening. It's already dark. I had no idea what kind of hotel to take.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I picked one out of Yellow Pages and got a taxi. When I gave him the address, he looked at me like a little funny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Whatever, what do I know? Keep on going. I need to get sleep because I was extremely tense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: having gone through customs and border control. We were going in the southern direction,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and I noticed that the neighborhoods became less and less inviting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I didn't know what that meant either. I entered the hotel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was a five-story brownstone, and something else looked funny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The reception desk was protected by plexiglass. Not having enough background, I didn't know that this was unusual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: All I knew was that there was a lot of crime in the United States, so I thought maybe every hotel was like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I go up into my room and drink a half a bottle of Johnny Walker Red because I was so tense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: As one does, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Because I was so damn tense, I just wanted to sleep. I wanted to get into a coma, which I did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The next day I woke up with a headache. It felt twice as big, but I was prepared. I had aspirin with me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I killed the headache and went outside to see if I could get something to eat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I was right smack in the middle of the south side of Chicago. I didn't know that the south side of Chicago existed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I found out later where I was. It was time to go very quickly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I go up there, and at that point I decided I would register at the next hotel under Jack Barsky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I went to the bathroom, and I tried to kill off Mr. Dyson by burning his passport.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Unfortunately, I was not trained in how to train passport, how to destroy passports.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I tried to burn it, and these things were flame retardant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It created a cloud of smoke, and I'm looking up there, and there's a smoke detector.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, oh no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Okay, so presence of mind, I threw this thing in the toilet, and then took out a pair of scissors and cut it into small pieces and flushed it down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: If that smoke alarm goes off, I'm busted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: If some criminal steals, I had $6,000 on me in cash, steals either my passport or my money or both, I don't know what to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, you can't go to the authorities. You can't do anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There weren't any Russian Soviets in Chicago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Do you have any contacts inside the America?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: No, there was no Plan B for Chicago at all. That's an oversight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I shouldn't have gone to Chicago. They could have shipped me into San Francisco or Washington, D.C. because both of them had Soviets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: My end goal was to go to New York. Fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I would have been a really, really dangerous agent if I had gone back and worked with the KGB, because I could have told them all the things, how to do it right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So in that sense, there is some, given the scale of the KGB, there is some incompetence in this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Some?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: A lot of incompetence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: With regard to preparing me to be an American, it was almost total incompetence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Do you think that's representative of the way they operate, as there is an incompetence to the logistics, to the strategies involved, all that kind of stuff?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: None of these guys had operated as illegals. They were outsiders to American society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They had interaction with Americans, but they all lived in New York.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They lived in a compound in northern Manhattan where they all lived together with their families.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Most of the time, they spent interacting with themselves, with their own people at work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So they really didn't integrate well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They did not know what it's like to be an American, to have a job, to live like an American. They didn't know it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's interesting that KGB didn't put a high value to that kind of integration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They didn't know what they didn't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And by the way, this was mutual. Do you think the CIA had good knowledge of the Russian culture?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Uh-uh. Same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And so there was a lot of lack of understanding because good intelligence could have possibly avoided some of the high tension situations that we had when in the 80s we got close to nuclear war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So good intelligence would be integrating yourself and society much, much deeper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And understanding that Ronald Reagan was not a warmonger, but he was talking about the end times because he was a Christian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But then that kind of integration can be dangerous because you start to question the propaganda, the narratives that on which the KGB is built, the CIA is built.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Oh, yeah. And then they always had the option of ignoring the intelligence that they're getting, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, let me ask you this question sort of to jump around. There is a lot of conspiracy theories in this current climate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I mean throughout history, but now especially.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And some of the conspiracy theories put a lot of power in the hands of the intelligence agencies like CIA, FSB, Mossad, MI6.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They're basically the conspiracy theories go that they control the powerful people in this world and are able to thereby manipulate those powerful people and manipulate the populace in order to deliver different kinds of messages and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Given your experience with this kind of tension between competence and malevolence, would you say there's some truth to those conspiracy theories?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Not one way. I think there is collusion, there's collaboration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But I would think that, like for instance, some folks in the CIA and the FBI are being used by the ones that are really in power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Power is money. Power is wealth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I know power is not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It can go both directions. You can acquire wealth first, which leads you to power, or you can acquire power first.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, power is also knowledge, I understand, and a position in society, in the military or in intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But I don't think it's a straight one way that all the intelligence agencies control the powerful people in their country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You see what's happening in Russia. I mean Putin dominates his intelligence agencies, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, so the question is which way the direction goes, but you're saying that it's not one way flow of power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I would think so. And I also believe it exists, but it's not as prevalent as, you know, not every conspiracy theory pans out, and most of them don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They're just damn rumors, but that doesn't mean they don't exist. I guarantee you they exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There's collusion. There's people getting together, and not necessarily preparing a specific action,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but more sort of a plan to go forward and maintain the position or even strengthen the position that they already have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So KGB, Burkina General, FSB, CIA, do you think a KGB agent would kill someone against international law if they were ordered to do so?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So we talked about…

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They did. They did. And there's a famous case of one, I think it's Vasily Kuklov, who defected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He was a killer. He was a trained killer, and he had done assassinations in other countries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He was sent to West Germany to kill a defector, a KGB defector, and he decided not to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He talked to the guy and he said, I'm supposed to kill you. I'm not. And then he eventually wound up in the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I have a connection to this fellow because the KGB once asked me to go to California and see if the guy still lives and works there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I found him, and we looked at each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So it was an active KGB agent looking at a man that he didn't know was a KGB defector, looking at each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Neither one knew who the other one was. I found out later.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But he was able to survive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes. And there have been assassinations, not a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And you know that…

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That we know of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: A good point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: This is very difficult. The question is how many lines are intelligence agencies willing to cross to achieve the goal?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I think none of these agencies have the ultimate line.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I think eventually the last line will be crossed if they believe it's necessary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, I think you can justify a lot of things, especially in this modern world with nuclear weapons, that you can justify it, that you're saving the world actually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Let me ask a few difficult questions and we'll jump back to your time in America.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But Vladimir Putin has been accused of ordering the poisoning and assassination of several people, including Alexander Levinenko early on, all the way to Alexei Navalny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Do you think these accusations are grounded in truth?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And we will return to a couple more questions maybe about Vladimir Putin's early days in the KGB, which would be interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, there's a phrase that I'd like to say in response is called plausible deniability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I don't think Putin gave a direct command as they do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He would just maybe muse, it would be nice if something were to happen, and then somebody picks it up and does it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Can you still man the case that Putin did not have direct or indirect involvement with this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Who would know?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, the international reputation, perhaps catalyzed by Putin himself, is that he is the kind of person that would directly or indirectly make those orders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Perhaps the case there is he's somebody to be feared, and thereby you won't have to worry about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But the act itself, the poisoning of Levinenko and the assassination of the Bulgarian Markov with the umbrella,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and they all directly traced back to Russian Soviet intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And so that's enough to be feared, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: My answer that I gave you is an educated guess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I can't pretend to know this for sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's frustrating to me because there's a lot of people listening to this would say, would even sort of would chuckle at the naive nature of the question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But if you actually keep an open mind, you have to understand what is the way that intelligence agencies function?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Is it possible to the head of an intelligence agency not to make direct orders of that kind?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Where there's a distributed...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: No, the head of the intelligence agency would most likely give the order.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Even though it's compartmentalized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, but not the head of state.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Maybe not the head of state.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Although in the case, this is the case in the United States as well, but certainly is the case in Russia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There are close relationships between the head of the FSB and the GRU and personal relationships, not just even...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The head of the FSB who was now in jail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There's interesting details, especially coming out recently around the war in Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So let me actually ask about the war in Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: All right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: What is your analysis of the war in Ukraine from 2014 to the full on invasion of Ukraine by Russia in 2022, in February 2022?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There's many questions we could ask.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: One is, what are the sins of the governments involved?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: What are the sins of Russia, Ukraine, America, China?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Are those sins comparable?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Who are the good guys and the bad guys?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That was more than one question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Let me just give you the basics about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Savvy observers saw this coming.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They were a very small minority.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Because Vladimir Putin was pretty open about what he told the world his mission was,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: was the reestablishment of a strong Russia, the reestablishment of something like the Russian Empire

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: to unite all the Russian speaking people in one country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the world ignored him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I mean, he was open.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He was at a conference in France, I believe, where he set this out in the open.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then what we had in the United States, we had wishful thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Obama had this reset with Russia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: We all get friendly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then when Putin invaded Crimea, we did nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But that was also out in public where he was, again, quite clear what he was going to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Now, how do you do this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: With force.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the sins committed by the American government was that we ignored it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and clearly respond to the actual statements and the essays and the words spoken.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes, but they also at the same time pressured Russia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And they also, as Putin himself said, sort of there's a rat and they pushed the rat towards the corner by expanding NATO.

body.input: I lived through 9-11.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I lived through the full roller coaster of emotion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I'm a, at that time, before that, and after was a proud American.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I went through the whole roller coaster of being sold, I would say, a lie about the reason to invade Iraq and even Afghanistan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I've got to live through understanding of this military industrial complex that leads to the expansion of vampires,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: of the delusion that we have in the populace, in the government that convinces us that we are the good guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And somehow with military force, we can instill our values, instill happiness, the pursuit of happiness, that all men are created equal.

body.input: These ideas into other lands.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Agreed. Two thoughts, if I may.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: We want to make the world just like us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's the romantic side and the sort of honest side, but it doesn't work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It failed every time. Afghanistan is a royal mess and would never become a functioning democracy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301
