body.input: They disappeared and then they came back. I don't know, somebody in that office called Berlin and said, what are we going to do? Are we allowed to use force?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The answer came back that Gorbachev said, absolutely not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: This is where Putin, all of a sudden, he was at one point a member of the greatest, the most powerful intelligence organization in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: All of a sudden, he was powerless and he had to watch. This was a defeat, a big one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Supposedly, a powerful intelligence agency cowering, crawling back into a position of weakness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He probably promised himself, never again, Russia needs to be great again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The KGB, FSB, Russia, the Russian Empire needs to rise again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There's a feeling for him that that's, as he talks about the collapse of the Soviet Union being a great tragedy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There's a feeling like that was never again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, and I believe that he has a strong conviction that, I don't know if he's religious, he carries the cross now, but I don't know what that means.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But somehow, it's the destiny of the Russian nation to be great. Whether it's determined by God or some higher power, that is very important for him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Of course, that nationalist idea is one that Americans share as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It could help the nation flourish, so by itself, it's not necessarily a bad thing. It's how it manifests itself is the question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, one other thing, if I were to get a chat with the Ukrainian president, I would ask him how many lives, what is the equation between giving up some land and how many lives are worth this land?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that's a good way to phrase the question. Of course, that question gets you killed in Ukraine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But because there's another part of that equation, which is it's not just land versus lives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's the sovereignty, the knowledge that you're free and you're self-determined.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And it's not about fighting for the particular land. It's saying we are messed up, corrupt, we have problems, it's a messy world, but it's our world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I think Stephen Crane has a poem about a man eating his own heart, and he was asked how does it taste, and he said, it's bitter, but I like it because it is bitter and because it is my heart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that there's a sense of like, I want this is not just about land, this is our nation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The same love of nation that Putin has for Russia, the greater Russia, this vision of this great empire, I believe Ukraine does as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There's levels to this game, and Ukrainian people are some of the proudest people throughout the history of the 20th century, throughout the history of Earth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The Polish people are proud people. You can just see in World War II, the people who said, fuck you, you're not having this, we will die to the last man.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There's different cultures that kind of really hold their ground, and Ukrainian people are that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You know, I have to admit in that respect, I'm a bit of a coward. I could not do what Stolinski has been doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I would sort of try to find a way to carve out something that I can live with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: However, if that force, that evil force gets to my family.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Right. There's lines.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's right. You become the world's bravest man if somebody crosses that line.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Oh, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You mentioned something about you've not been to Moscow back, and that it might not be safe for you to travel there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Can you speak to the nature of that? As somebody that successfully got out of the KGB, how are you still alive?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: A number of reasons. First of all, when my story became public, that was six years ago, I was pretty old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And so the folks that may have a personal interest or may have had a personal interest in doing me harm, most of them don't live anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's number one. Number two, I was a hired hand, a German. I did not betray the motherland.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's a crime that is punished by death. You betray the motherland.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the other thing is, you know that these kinds of operations to assassination in another country are very difficult to plan and implement.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And if there's a list of people that they don't like, I may not be at the very top.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Having said that, if I wind up, say, in Moscow or even in countries like Turkey where there's a lot of lawlessness, accidents can easily be arranged.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that's just sending another message. We can do a lot of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Do you think it's safe for me to travel in Russia and Ukraine?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I think you know very well how to communicate in both countries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You've shown this in this interaction that you have a lot of empathy for the people you'll be talking with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And empathy means good understanding where they're coming from. And then there are lines that you can't cross.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Like the question that I was going to ask Zelensky, who I'm not going to ask, good for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Isn't that the funny thing about this world? There's lines. There's lines everywhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Even in love, even in personal relationships, there's lines you should not cross.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: How did you finally get caught?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I resigned in 1988.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Let's actually talk about that. There's a resigned, there's warning signs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There's yet another choice, yet another crossroads.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: What was the calculation? What was the choice to be made?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: To give a little background, it was 1988.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I thought my time in the US would soon end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Because I thought 10 to 12 years, it was already past 10 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There was no indication that they indicated, that they said, you're done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But in December of 1988, I got this one thing that I never wanted to see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So we had a system of signals that either one of those diplomat agents could set at a spot that I pass by every day,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: or I could set where they would pass by, like on their way from where they lived to the United Nations, for instance, who would just drive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And mine was, the signal spot for me was on a support beam for the elevated atrium in Queens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And it was morning in December that I walked by there and routinely looked at it, and I never expected anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And there was this red dot, it was about the size of my fist with a red paint.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And since you have done it already, I think I can curse in this moment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: because it's the only way I can really indicate how I felt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I said, oh shit, because that was the danger signal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was like, you are in severe danger, and you need to get out of the country as soon as possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There was a protocol that I was supposed to follow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I wasn't even supposed to go home.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I just needed to, was supposed to get my reserve documents that I had hidden in a park in the Bronx

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and make a beeline to the Canadian border.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I wasn't ready.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I just ignored this thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I mean, I couldn't ignore it, but I went on to work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Got on the A train, went to work, and then went to my cubicle and stared at the computer screen all day because I couldn't think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I could only think about what to do, what to do, what to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The reason for this indecisiveness was that I was a father at the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: My little girl by the name of Chelsea was 18 months old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I was there when she was born.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I took her to her home.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I watched her grow up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I watched her take the first steps and always look at me with these big eyes, lovingly look at me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that is when I started my re-entry into the human race because I just fell in love with this girl.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's when love came back and it was completely unexpected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And there's a lot of fathers who understand, particularly fathers of girls, who understand what happened there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I still thought I need to go back because there was probably some danger, but I hadn't figured out how to take care of the girl.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I'd leave her, but maybe she needs to have a good life and grow up and have a chance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Her mother was from South America. She had a fourth grade education.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That would have not worked very well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I played for time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Obviously, I could be sick. I could be in a hospital.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There was a precedent where I was sick where I couldn't communicate for about three weeks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I just did nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There was on a Monday. On a Thursday was my regular shortwave transmission.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I listened and they explained a little in a few sentences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: We have reason to believe that the FBI is on your case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You need to execute the emergency procedure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Come home right away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I still had some time because the radio could be broken or the transmission was bad or I still could be in a hospital.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I gave myself some more time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then something happened where they forced my hand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The only time that a Soviet agent was anywhere near me on the territory of the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I'm waiting for the A train on a dark morning still in Queens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And there's this man, a short man in a black trench coat comes up to me from my right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And he whispers into my ears, you got to come back or else you're dead.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I can't imitate the Russian accent. It was a Russian accent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And it was a pretty strong accent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The you're dead phrase can have two meanings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And an American would have said or else you're busted or else you get arrested or else you're dead is very strong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So now you have to take it seriously to some degree because I know that they had a history of assassinating

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: or at least trying to assassinate the factor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So that obviously raised the stakes a little bit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But I just talked myself into believing this was just bad phrasing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But at this point I knew and they knew that we both knew.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So there was no more guessing. He found me, he talked to me, I know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So now I had to act.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So in the next radiogram I was asked to execute a debt drop operation where they would give me money and a passport.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that was in a park on Staten Island.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was a location that I found and I described.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I was always praised for my ability to describe spots that are easy to find.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So that was a given.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the only thing that was different for this operation, they scheduled it for the dark.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But it was still no problem because it was in a park and a couple of hundred yards in next to a fallen tree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It would be hard to miss.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I go to Staten Island and I read the signal that said I put the container in the drop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That was the protocol.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There's a signal that the person who hands over something puts at a spot not too far from the spot itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That means I would go in and just pick it up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The reason I actually went to pick up this container because there was money in it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I didn't have to make a decision yet.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I could throw away the passport.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was like I was still trying to figure out what to do, what to do, what to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I get to the spot, I get to the tree, and I had a flashlight with me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The park, there was nowhere in the park.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Even during the day, this park was more almost like a little forest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I don't see the container.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It wasn't supposed to be a crushed oil can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Pretty sizable, hard to miss.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I do a double take and I look again and I look around and I look around a little more,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: see if they misplaced it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I can't find it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's the only one that one of those operations failed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that just doesn't make a lot of sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So when as I'm walking away from this, like sort of numb emotionally,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I said to myself, I'm staying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That kind of signal, some kind of muse just spoke to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That decision was made for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Now, you know that I'm a Christian now and I think it was like God told me this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But it was certain there. It was right there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That was it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That was it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah. So what I did to, well, first of all, divine intervention helped me to find a good explanation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I sent them my last letter with secret writing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I communicated to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I said, I wish I could come, but I can't because I have contracted HIV AIDS.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was the best lie ever because nobody wanted to have AIDS in their country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: In those days, it was a death sentence, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I knew we had conversations when I was back in Moscow,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: how they were snickering about what's going on in the United States, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that depraved culture and you see them, they're killing each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the depraved culture took over your being and how you're saying it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I was convincing enough, I even traced it back to a girlfriend I had once

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that I actually reported on that I interacted with this lady who had a boyfriend at one point

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: who was a drug addict and she was infected and she infected me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So they believed it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They sent, and I asked them to give my dollar savings to my German family.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They gave them some, but they told my family that I already passed away, that I'm dead.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They believed it, 100%.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I guess the agent who took the money took half of it for himself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So that was it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the next three months, I made sure that I wasn't reliably at the same spot in the same time frame.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I went to work in different paths at different times just to, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: just to a safety measure, so to speak, and not huge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But, you know, it kept me, allowed me to keep my sanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And obviously after I sent the letter, I threw the shortwave radio in the Hudson River,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: destroyed the one-time pads that I still had, so I was now ready to...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: For a new life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: For a new life and live out my life as an American undiscovered,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but, you know, starting to work on my version of the American dream.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the first action was telling my wife, the mother of this child,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: you know, she always wanted to have a house and said, you know what, we should buy a house.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And a year later we moved into the suburbs and then I said, we should have another child, and we had another child.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So, and I had a career where I did pretty well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I moved a couple of times, wound up in a McMansion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But before that, my second house was actually in Pennsylvania, in rural Pennsylvania.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And this is where I was discovered by the FBI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And how did they know about me?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: If it hadn't been for this defector, Vasily Mitrokin, who was an archivist in the KGB archives,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: he was actually pretty high level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He was in charge of the relocation of the archive from Ljubljana to Yasenovo.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And he really hated the, he had reason to believe he hated the Soviet system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I think I remember that his son was quite ill and he could have gotten treatment in England,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and he was not allowed to travel to England with his son.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So, his hatred, he tried to figure out what to do and how to do damage to that system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He started copying notes, little slips of paper, handwritten,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that he smuggled out in his underwear and his socks over the years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then he transcribed them with a typewriter and then put the pieces of paper

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: into some kind of a container and buried this in his stacha.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was, I believe, in 1992 when he showed up, that was already the Soviet Union was gone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So, he showed up at the US Embassy in Moscow and told them what he had.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And it was on a weekend and apparently there was a junior person in charge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And he said, you know what, what you got we are not interested in, it's really old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's a career limiting move, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Because Vasily Mitrokin then made his way to one of the Baltic Republics and contacted MI6.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And they said, come on in old fellow, have a cup of tea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And so they managed to get this stuff out of the dacha and get it to England.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And eventually MI6 shared it with the FBI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And there wasn't a whole lot of information about me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was very, very little.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was like there's a person by the name of Jack Barsky who is an illegal operating in the northeast of the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Now, if it was Jim Miller, they wouldn't have found me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Jack Barsky was easy to find.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So, they checked Social Security and Jack Barsky had gotten his Social Security card at the age of 33.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Bingo, okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: All they knew though was that I wasn't illegal, that I was still living there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They didn't know whether I was active, inactive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the other thing that they knew that I was a really, really well-trained agent because I was still there, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So, they took I think almost three years to investigate me, watch me from a distance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Because if I was still active, I would have found out that somebody is investigating me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So, you started being less and less active in terms of...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Oh, I stopped completely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: What I mean is...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Oh, surveillance detection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes, surveillance detection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: After three months, I stopped altogether.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, good point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And FBI is still very careful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They were very careful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They pretty much watched me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And at one point, I had a house in the country with one neighbor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: At one point, that house was for sale, so the FBI bought it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And they put a couple of agents there and just to keep a closer eye on me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There was no indication that I was still active, but they were still cautious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But at one point, they were able to plant a bug in my kitchen, a listening device.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And my wife and I didn't get along very well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There was a lot of friction and she was constantly complaining about things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I got sick and tired of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And one day, we had an argument in the kitchen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I chose to deploy the nuclear option.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that is telling her what I sacrificed to be with her, so she would understand that I am there on her side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I'm supporting her.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: If something doesn't quite fit, it is not because I don't love the both of them, Chelsea and Penelope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So when I said that, the listening device was active, so the FBI was hearing my confession.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I was once a KGB agent, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I quit because of – and then stayed here because of you and Chelsea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that also made it clear to the FBI that I wasn't active anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They had both of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So now, they knew an attempt to turn me would have been useless because you turned somebody who was active.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But they figured there was enough reason to treat me nicely because they figured I had a lot of information

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: that was as aged as it was, but it was still important for the FBI to get to know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And so one day, it was a Friday evening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I'm driving back home from the office and I'm being stopped by a state police.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: As I'm going through the toll – it's a bridge over the Hudson and they had to pay a toll.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And he waved me – he got me right where I stopped and he said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: could you please move over here, it's a routine traffic stop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I thought nothing of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I had forgotten at that point that I once was a spy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was gone.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then he said, could you please step out of the car.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That should have aroused my suspicion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's unusual, right, routine traffic stop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, I did it, no problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then again, somebody came from the right, came into my view and he flipped this ID and said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: FBI, we would like to have a talk with you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: This is my now friend Joe Reilly, who actually is the – he's the godfather of Trinity and my last child.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But anyway, he told me later that when I heard that phrase, all the blood left my face.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I became totally white.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But I recovered very quickly and he said it himself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So they took me to a vehicle and there was another agent in the vehicle and he had a gun strapped to his ankle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So it was pretty real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: First question I had, so am I under arrest?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the answer was no.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then my instinct kicked in and my ability to operate very well under high pressure situations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I asked him, so what took you so long?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the intent of that was to defuse any kind of tension.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I saw a smile.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Instant friends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, I knew that I had to make them like me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I think by now I know I'm a pretty likeable person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I would say so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And when they took me to a motel, which they had rented, there was two wings at a right angle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They bought all the rooms in one wing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And they had a guard at each end of that wing and they took me in the middle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And there were some props there, some binders with labels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I immediately thought, this is pretty silly because what I noticed that the labels all referred back to my early years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I knew that they didn't know much else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So I told Joe that afterwards and that was not a great idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But anyway, but I volunteered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I made the following statement before we even started the interview.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I said, I know there's only one way for me and my family to have a chance to get through here without much damage

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: if I'm completely 100% cooperative and it's my intent to do exactly that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: All right, so we spent about two hours in the interview.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They allowed me to call my wife, tell her that I'm going to be late.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That indicated to me already that they would let me go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And after two hours, they let me go.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But they had the area covered with all bunch of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the head of that team talked to me and he said, if you think of running,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: we got every intersection in this area covered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You can't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I didn't say anything, but I had no thought of running.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So and that was the beginning of another phase of my life where I was cooperating with the FBI for quite a while

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and living still undercover for several years until I had real good documentation

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and became an American citizen seven years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: From today seven years ago. So recently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, quite recent.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: The bureaucracy took a long time to figure out how to make me real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And also not put me in these witness protection program, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: to keep my name and then just make everything official.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So, for instance, I had to change my birth year simply because if I,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Jack Barsky was born in 1944.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: If I kept 1944, the FBI would have helped me commit a crime

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: because I would have collected Social Security of four years sooner.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So anyway, yes, it took quite a while.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And when I finally got the call from the Office of Homeland Security,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: the lady says, this is agent so and so from Homeland Security.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Can you come into the office tomorrow?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I said, let me look at my calendar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then I said, wait a minute, what am I talking about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: What time do you want me to be there?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Because I had waited for that moment for a long time and I was sworn in right then and there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It was a good feeling to walk out of there because I had a country again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You know, and I love this country just as much as you said you love it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: With all its warts and its problems that we're going through right now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then the last thing that changed my life again,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and I don't want to get into details because it's a little complicated story,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I never wanted to be a public person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And then I was discovered through a number of dots that were unlikely to be connected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It had to do with a relative, with a half brother of my wife who lives in Germany,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: was taken to Germany by his mother, who came to visit somebody, not us,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: but that somebody that he came to visit lived 50 miles from our house.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that my wife and this half brother never met in person before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: They knew about each other through social media.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And when he found out my background, he was a conductor of the German Railroad at the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He said, oh, this is a big story, that's going to be big, big, big.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, he happened to know this one person who happened to know

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: one of the star reporters of Der Spiegel.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And after she did some research and determined that I was real, she was on my case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And she happened to know Steve Croft, the guy from 60 Minutes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You see all these connections? I had nothing to do with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's how life works. Dots get connected somehow, sometimes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: For most of us it doesn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Stuff happens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You get lucky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You don't know what's happening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You've gotten lucky a few times in your life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, I think I must be part Irish too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, so it's been an interesting ride.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I'm just still shaking my head about all the stuff that happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's been a fun one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You wrote, because I'm allowed to leave behind a documented legacy of my unusual life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I'm praying that the legacy will be described by a single word, love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So let us return to the thing we started the conversation with, which is love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: What role does love play in this human condition, in your life and in our life here together?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I'll give you an answer telling you what happened one day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I gave a presentation at Microsoft headquarters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's a strange beginning of a love story, but yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: No, that's not a love story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So there's this beautiful young lady sitting in the back, and she's paying a lot of attention.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Found out later that her job at Microsoft, her job title was storyteller.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's soft marketing, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, you could say that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, but if you can't afford somebody like that, that's good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Anyway, question and answer, she raised her hand and she asked me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: all the things that you have done and you've experienced, what's the number one lesson you've taken away from your life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That was a new question for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I've never been asked that question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I thought about it for 20 seconds, and then I came up with this phrase that we all know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: love conquers all, because in my life it did, in the end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And it's the strongest human emotion, and that is what makes us human, really.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You spoke about the, I mean, offline, as I've spoken with you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: it's clear to me how transformative, how powerful the life of your children are,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: your daughters in your life, in who you are, in why you think life is beautiful,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: in why you think this country is beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Now that I'm pretty mature, to put it mildly, I'm also more loving towards many more people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You know, these things like random acts of kindness for strangers, I do them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I'm looking for them now. And you know what? It's good for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, welcome to Texas, because this random acts of kindness for strangers seems to be a way of life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: which is one of the reasons I love it here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It just reminds me why I love human beings, which is that there's just this warmth, this connection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, and Georgia is the same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah. Amen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Do you ever need regrets?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Looking back on life, do you wish you'd done something different?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, I could have, but then I would have a different regret.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I betrayed the wife, the German wife that I loved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I really did love her, and I betrayed her.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But if I don't betray her, then I betray the child.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That is a source of so much love for you now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So maybe life is a kind of, you get to choose your regrets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, it's a little bit of a strange way of putting it, but there's no other choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I tell you what I don't regret, and that may be, you probably understand it now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: because you have enough background about me, I don't regret having lied to my mother,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: because I had no really strong emotional relationship with her.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: She took care of me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: She was proud of me, but we didn't hug.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: We didn't interact emotionally whatsoever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So you don't feel like you betrayed that love that...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Well, I did. I know that she was looking for me until the day she died.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: She wrote a letter to President Gorbachev asking him for help to locate me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: She checked with Astazi.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: She just was like hell-bent on finding me and couldn't find me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and she passed away without knowing what happened to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Now, there was this rumor that was flying around,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and she possibly may have bought into that rumor,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: because my cover for when I went to the United States was that I changed careers again,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and I joined an institution in Kazakhstan that did space research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Intercosmos something-something, and I had a piece of paper that invited me to start there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and it was a forgery. Intercosmos never existed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But people knew that in Kazakhstan there were super secret facilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: One of my old classmates from high school started the rumor that I died in a rocket accident,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and everybody knew that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So when I came back to Germany, I found the telephone number of this girl that had dumped me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I called her, and I said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: so guess who this is, maybe you hold onto your chair.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: She says yes, I said, this is Albrecht.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It's a good payback.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: No, we actually met.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: So there's two elderly people in their 60s who meet each other after so many years,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and the one that ended the relationship started the conversation by saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: you know what, I made a really bad mistake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the tears came down her cheeks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I wasn't asking for that. I wasn't happy about it, but it did feel good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Now, a while later, I knew why she said she made a mistake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I met her husband.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, I mean, there's a Tom Ways song called Martha, where an older gentleman calls somebody he used to love,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: and they have a conversation. They're both married now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And sometimes you can meet people from your past, and it gives you a glimpse of a possible different life you could have had.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Oh, yeah. And you know, I was actually, when she said I made a mistake, and I was thinking to myself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: no, you didn't. There was nothing left.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: There was nothing left. And also the person that you became, personality-wise, wasn't as attractive as I remembered her.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You know, it's puppy love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But it's still love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah, it was. It was passionate love for sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I would have thrown myself under the bus if I could save her. It was that strong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And just as strong as the love for my two girls.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Life is full of moments and periods like that of love, and that's what makes life so freaking awesome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But it does come to an end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And so does this conversation, I guess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: No, this goes on for many more hours, but yes. Do you think about your own death?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Huh?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Do you think about death? Do you think about your own death?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Are you afraid of it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes, even though I'm a Christian.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: As a Christian, do you have a sense of what's coming after? Or is it full of uncertainty?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I have a hope. I have a hope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You know, there's a lot of Christianity, which is quite logical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: A lot of Christianity, which is also, you know, the life of Christ has a lot of proof.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But, you know, I became a Christian starting with a head.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I was already quite old.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I, you know, when you don't get this faith very early, it's tougher to buy into everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You know, there are some things that are difficult for me to understand and believe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But there's many, many other things that I can't explain only with the existence of a God.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But whether He lets us go again for in eternity, I just hope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I won't convince somebody else at this point, which doesn't make me a really, really good Christian, because I'm supposed to evangelize.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: But there's still a fear. There's a fear and a hope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: On the other hand, I know that, you see, this is how I approached the last years of my life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I will not mentally or physically get decrepit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I will do everything I can do to be alert and fit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: I still run. I run four or five times a week.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I'm going to start lifting weights again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Good. You stay physically and mentally sharp.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Go out with guns blazing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And I once read a book written by a medical doctor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He said most people, when they're becoming mature, the rest of their life is a slow downward move.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the...

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Not for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: No, the last years are pretty bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: He said, you got to do this. Boom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: That's pretty good advice from a doctor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And if nothing else from Christianity, whichever parts you take on, one of the big ones is love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And that's something you've lived from the very beginning before God was part of your life, before anything was part of your life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: It seemed that love was part of your life and has been a consistent thread throughout.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Yes, sir.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And there's a short sentence in the Bible that says, God is love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And the other thing I want to say, the Christian morality is I can sign that with my blood.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: God is love. Amen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Jack, you're an incredible person.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: You have lived an incredible life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Thank you for talking today.

body.input: Thank you for telling your story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Thank you for being who you are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: And thank you for being all about love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: This is a beautiful conversation. It was an honor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jack Barsky: KGB Spy | Lex Fridman Podcast #301

body.input: Thank you for talking today.
